heading: 1. First things to do when your shift starts
text: Screen to open: Dashboard Logged in with your own account Read the handover from the previous shift Checked today's reservation and check-in counts in the 「チェックイン状況」 (Check-in status) and 「予約状況」 (Reservation status) tables Checked the counts for 「未(昨日以前)」 (Not yet (yesterday or earlier)), 「未部屋割り」 (Unassigned) and 「オーバーブッキング」 (Overbooking), and the guests with unpaid amounts or who need attention Looked at 「清掃状況(本日)」 (Cleaning status (today)) and checked for room changes or arrival time changes to pass on to the cleaning staff When you are doneYou are done when you can explain out loud "who is arriving today, who is leaving, and what to watch out for."

heading: 2. How to read the dashboard
text: This is the first screen after you log in. Check the overall picture for today before editing any reservation details. The dashboard at Tanegashima Araki Hotel is laid out as follows (checked 2026-10-10). Top row This month's booked sales / This month's actual sales / Sales target and achievement rate Middle row Occupancy rate / Reservations with repeat status not yet judged / Reservations received (today, this month) / Check-ins (today, this month) Bottom row Check-in status (not yet (today), done (today), not yet (yesterday or earlier)) / Cleaning status (today) (scheduled, not arranged, not completed, reports awaiting review) Reservation status table (at the very bottom) Rooms / Today's reservations / Today's cleaning, not completed / Tomorrow's reservations / Tomorrow's cleaning, not arranged / Unassigned / Automatic room assignment failed / Overbooking. Click a number to go to the matching list. Top and middle rows of the dashboard. They show this month's sales and target, occupancy rate, reservations received, check-ins, and more. Every morning the front desk looks at 「チェックイン状況」 (Check-in status), 「清掃状況(本日)」 (Cleaning status (today)) and the 「予約状況」 (Reservation status) table. 「未(昨日以前)」 (Not yet (yesterday or earlier)) means missed check-ins, and 「未部屋割り」 (Unassigned) and 「オーバーブッキング」 (Overbooking) need action today. Unassigned reservations are assigned a room before arrival (checked 2026-10-10). Bottom of the dashboard: 「チェックイン状況」 (Check-in status), 「清掃状況(本日)」 (Cleaning status (today)) and, at the very bottom, the 「予約状況」 (Reservation status) table. Click a number to go to the matching list.

heading: 3. Check room status
text: Left menu → 客室の状況表 (Room status chart) The "Label" column of the table shows the status names on the screen (from the official manual. On Araki Hotel's screen, 「宿泊中」 (In house), 「チェックイン予定」 (Arriving), 「チェックアウト待ち」 (Awaiting check-out) and 「空室」 (Vacant) have been confirmed). Label Meaning What the front desk does 空室 (Vacant) A room with no reservation that day Check the cleaning status too before assigning it チェックイン予定 (Arriving) Scheduled to check in that day and not checked in yet Check the name, number of guests, payment and notes 宿泊中 (In house) Checked in and staying beyond that day Handle room moves and extensions from the reservation details チェックアウト待ち (Awaiting check-out) Checked in and scheduled to check out that day Check unpaid amounts and additional usage 清掃待ち (Awaiting cleaning) Cleaning is scheduled today and has not started yet Do not show guests to the room until cleaning is finished. Check the status with the cleaning staff 清掃中 (Cleaning) Today's cleaning has started and is not finished yet Wait for cleaning to be completed ノーショウ (No-show) A reservation that started on or before the previous day and has not checked in yet If left as is, it counts toward sales and the occupancy rate (from the official manual). Check the contact status and report to the manager (person in charge) オーバーブッキング (Overbooking) The same room has two or more reservations with overlapping dates Do not move either one on your own; contact the manager ブロック中 (Blocked) Taken off sale because of a breakdown, construction work, etc. Check the reason and period, and do not release it on your own How colors are applied, and reservations that do not appear on the chart (from the official manual)When one room matches more than one state, it is shown in this order of priority: Cleaning > Overbooking > Awaiting check-out > Awaiting cleaning > Arriving > In house > No-show > Vacant. See also Check room status). heading: 4. Check in
text: 客室の状況表 (Room status chart) → 当日分の予約検索 (Search today's reservations) → open the room Enter the guest's name in ［当日分の予約検索］ (Search today's reservations) at the top of the room status chart to find the reservation (room). The matching room is highlighted. You can also use 「スマート予約検索」 (Smart reservation search) at the very top of the screen to search all reservations, including those not for today (separate multiple conditions with spaces; 「過去分も表示」 (Show past ones too) can also be used). Step 1: "Tanegashima" entered in ［当日分の予約検索］ (Search today's reservations) on the room status chart. The matching room is highlighted. Read through the stay dates, number of guests, room type and notes together with the guest. Check the items the property requires, such as guest information and ID documents. Also check whether the room shows the 「宿泊台帳未入力」 (Guest register not filled in) or 「要領収書」 (Receipt required) icon (from the official manual. When guest information has been entered on My Page, 「マイページ入力済み」 (Entered on My Page) appears above the lead guest's name in the details. Not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). Check the room number and that cleaning is complete. If the reservation is unassigned, assign a room according to the manager's rules. Steps 2–4: The details that open when you click a room. You can check guest information and stay information here. The 「チェックイン」 (Check in) button is also here. For a reservation whose information has been entered on My Page, 「マイページ入力済」 (Entered on My Page) appears in the guest information area of the room details (example screen from the official manual; this is a demo property's screen). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル (official online manual, in Japanese)) Check whether an outstanding balance is shown in red (whether the room shows the 「未収金あり（￥）」 (Outstanding balance (￥)) icon), and take any payment needed. According to the official manual, a warning pop-up appears if you try to check in while an outstanding balance remains (not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). Run 「チェックイン」 (Check in) and confirm that the screen shows 「宿泊中」 (In house). Step 6: The status change panel that opens when you press 「チェックイン」 (Check in). Check the room to check in, confirm whether to send a notification (off in this example), and run it. Hand over the key and the hotel information. When to stopIf you cannot find the reservation, the stay dates or number of guests are different, the room has not been cleaned, or the amount to pay differs from the reservation confirmation, do not change anything based on guesses. Check "Troubleshooting" and contact the manager. Room status chart after check-in. The room changes to in house (yellow-green). When you are doneThe reservation status is 「宿泊中」 (In house) (「チェックイン済み（宿泊中）」 (Checked in (in house)) in the reservation details), and the room number, payment and key handover all match.

heading: Tablet self check-in
text: Araki Hotel uses the check-in tablet (らくらくチェックイン (Easy check-in), verification video, support call, etc.) (owner's decision, 2026-10-11). The settings for what the tablet shows are in Set up the check-in tablet (administrator). According to the official manual, the guest's steps are as follows (the screen order and wording are not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). Choose a language, then choose check-in. Enter the 6-digit check-in code received by email or on My Page, or hold up the QR code (depending on the settings, the reservation can also be found without a code, by name or phone number, number of guests and check-out date). Read the information and agree to the terms and conditions of accommodation and other terms. Enter the guest information. Items already entered on My Page can be skipped. Verify identity (record a verification video, etc.). The completion screen shows the room number and other information. What the front desk should know (from the official manual) When a guest presses 「サポート通話」 (Support call) on the tablet, a video call connects to the property's staff (the settings for the PC that receives it are in Decide the identity verification method). For passports and face photos, recording and registration cannot finish unless a face is visible (other documents are not checked). For a multi-guest reservation where guests arrive at different times, if the property settings allow 「宿泊者別チェックイン」 (Check-in per guest), guests who arrive later can enter the same code and do their own check-in. Payment on the tablet cannot be split. Guests who want to split payment pay at the front desk. How to handle errors shown on the tablet (such as 「チェックインコードが不正です」 (The check-in code is invalid)) is covered in Troubleshooting. Not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel. Call center identity verification (paid option, from the official manual)A service for unstaffed hours in which an operator verifies the guest's identity by video call. It runs 24 hours a day in three languages (Japanese, English and Chinese) and checks the name, number of guests and number of nights, and for foreign nationals, that the face matches the passport photo. It only verifies identity; the operators do not take help calls (support calls). After entering their information, the guest chooses a language, starts the call, answers the questions, and presses 「次へ進む」 (Next) when verification is done. Because the system cannot tell whether the call has ended, 「次へ進む」 (Next) becomes available after the set wait time (30–180 seconds, default 30 seconds). If it is set too short, guests can move on without a call. If audio or video does not come through, go through check-in with a test reservation and check the camera and microphone from the gear icon on the call screen. Whether Araki Hotel has subscribed to this option is not yet confirmed. According to the official manual, self check-in guide materials for guests (for posting in the hotel and for attaching to emails) are provided and can be edited to fit the property (not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel).

heading: 5. Check out
text: 客室の状況表 (Room status chart) → 当日分の予約検索 (Search today's reservations) → open the room On the room status chart, open the room by the guest's name (［当日分の予約検索］ (Search today's reservations)) or by room number. Check the room charge, additional charges and the amount already paid. If anything is unpaid, confirm the payment method and take payment. Check whether a receipt is needed, and the addressee and description. For amounts prepaid on a booking site, the hotel does not issue a receipt; direct the guest to the booking site's receipt (from the official manual. Issue a receipt). Confirm that the key has been returned and press 「チェックアウト」 (Check out) in the room details. If the 「チェックアウト」 (Check out) button does not appear (for example, when the status chart's date is not yet the check-out date; checked 2026-10-05), choose 「チェックアウト済みにする」 (Mark as checked out) from the status at the top right of the reservation details, select the rooms to check out, and run it. Step 5 (when the 「チェックアウト」 (Check out) button does not appear on the status chart): The menu that opens when you press 「チェックイン済み（宿泊中）▼」 (Checked in (in house)) at the top right of the reservation details. Choose 「チェックアウト済みにする」 (Mark as checked out). The status change panel that opens next. Check the rooms to check out and run it. Confirm that the status has changed to 「チェックアウト済み」 (Checked out), and let the cleaning staff know. Step 6: Reservation details with the status changed to 「チェックアウト済み」 (Checked out). Check additional usage firstIf there is food and drink, shop purchases, an extension or similar, add it to the statement before pressing check-out.

heading: 6. Hand over to the next shift
text: Do not assume "it's obvious if you look." Leave notes so the next person can act without hesitation. Guests who have not arrived or are arriving late, and the contact status Unpaid amounts, amount discrepancies, refunds pending Room moves, breakdowns, blocks, rooms awaiting cleaning Items lent out, items arranged, special handling Requests from guests, and who does what next ExampleWrite the subject, the content, what has been done and what remains, for example: "Room 305, Mr./Ms. Tanaka / extension cord on loan / to be returned at check-out / next person on duty confirms the return."

heading: 7. Daily closing (manager)
text: Administrators and the manager only This process finalizes the sales and payments for the business day. If the property has enabled the feature, the 「日次の締めを行う」 (Run daily closing) button appears on the daily closing screen after the set closing time, and the manager checks everything and then presses it to close the day. Only an administrator enables it the first timeAfter deciding Araki Hotel's policy for using it, who is responsible, the closing time and how to reconcile, open 【売上管理】→【日次締め機能】 (Sales management → Daily closing feature), check the target property and closing time, and run 「日次締め機能を有効化する」 (Enable the daily closing feature). Regular front desk staff do not set this. Once enabled, the daily closing feature cannot be disabled from the admin screen. Also, when it was enabled after that day's closing time had already passed, the days up to the previous day were closed on the spot (checked 2026-10-06). Reservations, charges and payments on closed days can no longer be changed, so before enabling it, check that no reservations or payments that need fixing remain. At Tanegashima Araki Annex, once the closing time (04:00 every day) passes, the 「日次の締めを行う」 (Run daily closing) button appears at the very bottom of the daily closing screen. The day is not closed automatically even after the closing time (checked 2026-10-07). After the closing time, the manager closes the day with the following steps. A day runs from 04:00 to 03:59 the next day (from the official manual)According to the official manual, the 24 hours from the closing time make up one day for that property. Araki Hotel's closing time is 04:00, so payments and charges entered between midnight and 4:00 are treated as part of the previous day (not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). Open 【売上管理】→【日次締め機能】 (Sales management → Daily closing feature), press 「再取得」 (Reload) to get the latest state, and check the target date (a date not yet closed), the reservations with notices, the payment information and the advance payment information. Step 1: Tanegashima Araki Hotel's daily closing screen. Check the target date and the list of 「注意点のある予約」 (Reservations with notices). Check that no check-ins or check-outs were missed on the target date (the day being closed). Check unpaid amounts and discrepancies by payment type, such as cash and card. Check that no reservations or statement items are left unhandled. If there are discrepancies or unprocessed items, handle them before closing. If there are no problems, press 「日次の締めを行う」 (Run daily closing). In the confirmation 「（物件名）の（日付）分の売上・売掛金を締めますか？」 (Close sales and accounts receivable for (property name) for (date)?), check the property name and date, then press OK (checked 2026-10-07). Closing does not stop even if reservations with notices remainAccording to the official manual, even if notices (errors) are shown, pressing 「OK」 on the confirmation screen continues the closing, and when there are errors the confirmation screen appears a second time. If a second confirmation screen appears, it means unhandled reservations remain. Go back without pressing OK, handle them, and then close again (the wording of the second confirmation screen is not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). Data cannot be edited after closingThe official front operations manual says that data from closed days cannot be edited. Because nothing can be changed after closing, handle discrepancies and unprocessed items before pressing 「日次の締めを行う」 (Run daily closing). Current real screenTanegashima Araki Annex: daily closing feature enabled (closing time 04:00 every day). After the closing time, the 「日次の締めを行う」 (Run daily closing) button appears, and you press it to close (checked 2026-10-07). Tanegashima Araki Hotel: enabled on 2026-10-09 (04:00 every day) (checked 2026-10-09). Closed through 2026-10-09 (done 2026-10-10 07:05).

heading: 8. Output reports and CSVs (manager)
text: For administrators and the manager 分析帳票 (Analysis reports) → 帳票・CSV出力 (Report/CSV output) (for the income and expenditure report: 売上管理 (Sales management) → 収支実績報告書 (Income and expenditure results report)) These reports are used to check daily sales and payments and to output guest lists. The following summarizes the official manual's explanations; the output results are not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel. Every report is output per property, so output the main building and the annex separately. Terms to know first (from the official manual)"Charges" are the amounts billed to the guest, and "payments" are the amounts actually received. Sales count on each charge's "usage date," and charges with no usage date count on the reservation's check-out date. Amounts paid with points are included in sales. The monthly totals in reports are updated once a day, and 「集計日時」 (Aggregation date/time) at the top right shows when they were totaled. What you want to know Report to use Rooms occupied, number of guests and sales for a day Occupancy output Amounts received by payment method (to reconcile with the register) Payment information / Payment information (breakdown) Outstanding balances of in-house guests In-house receivables, Advance payment and in-house receivable balance list Who changed charges or payments Charges/payments update history Guest register Guest register, Guest information list Reservation lists (such as a list of today's arrivals) Reservation CSV Sales, expenses and payments finalized after closing Income and expenditure results report

heading: Occupancy output (occupancy and sales for one day)
text: In 〖分析〗 (Analysis), choose the property and date under 「稼働出力」 (Occupancy output) and press 「出力する」 (Output); one Excel file is saved. If you press it without choosing a property, nothing is output. It shows the rooms and capacity available for sale (excluding rooms taken out of service), rooms occupied and total guests, the number of rooms for same-day bookings, no-shows and same-day cancellations, sales for the day and month-to-date (including and excluding tax), a comparison with the same day last year, and a breakdown of sales other than room charges. If you choose the last day of the month, the month-to-date total is the total for that month. The daily closing time (04:00 at Araki Hotel) is the boundary of a day. Reservations canceled after the target date are still included in that day's results. Non-reservation charges are added in, and items for point use, tax, charges not counted as sales and partial payments are excluded.

heading: Payment information CSV and payment information (breakdown) CSV
text: Output it from 「精算情報」 (Payment information) in 〖会計〗 (Accounting), choosing the property and period (up to 1 month). With a row for each payment method and a column for each date, it lists the total of the payments whose payment date is that day (with refunds subtracted). The top row is 「支払い方法未入力」 (Payment method not entered). 「精算情報（内訳）」 (Payment information (breakdown)) is output for one chosen day and lists each payment whose payment date is that day on its own row (registration date and time, check-in code, room number, amount, payment method, accounts receivable party, remarks, etc.). For non-reservation charges and payments, the check-in code and lead guest name are blank. Both include reservation and non-reservation items. The date in the file name of the period total is the output date (for properties using daily closing, the closing date). Payment methods set to 「表示しない」 (Do not display) are left out entirely if there were no payments with them in the period, and appear if there were. No report filters payments by payment date, so the breakdown of OTA (online travel agency) prepayments cannot be seen in this report.

heading: Advance payment and in-house receivable balance list CSV
text: Shows, for each reservation as of the chosen date, the balance of advance payments (amounts received in advance) and in-house receivables (amounts not yet received). Choose the property and date (up to today) to output it. It can be output only for properties using daily closing. One row per reservation (one per registration for non-reservation items), and reservations with neither balance are not output. For non-reservation rows, the check-in code column shows 「（予約外）」 (Non-reservation) and the date columns are empty. Charges are counted by usage date (if there is none, the check-out date for reservations and the registration date for non-reservation items), and charges minus payments decides whether it is an advance payment or a receivable. Canceled reservations are not included.

heading: In-house receivables CSV
text: Output it from 「滞在未収金」 (In-house receivables) in 〖会計〗 (Accounting), choosing the property and target date (today or earlier). It is the report version of the in-stay payment checklist. Each room in house (checked in) on the target date is listed on its own row, with the total outstanding balance excluding and including tax. Rooms with a 0-yen balance are also listed. Reservations not yet checked in and reservations already checked out are not listed. Charges dated after the target date, charges not counted as sales, and items linked to partial payments or specified-amount payments are not counted as outstanding.

heading: Charges/payments update history CSV (operation history)
text: Shows when and by whom charges and payments were created, changed or deleted. It is output per property, for a period of up to 3 months. If you specify a reservation by check-in code or OTA reservation number, all of that reservation's history is output regardless of the operation date (non-reservation slips are not included). You can filter by charges or payments, and by new, deleted, before change and after change. A change is recorded as two rows, "before change" and "after change." The operator column (column D) shows who made the operation, such as staff, tablet or site controller, and if separate accounts are used, the account name appears.

heading: Guest register (the register required by the Hotel Business Act)
text: Output it from 「宿泊者台帳」 (Guest register) in 〖旅館業法対応_帳票〗 (Hotel Business Act reports), choosing the property, period and condition. It cannot be output if there are more than 5000 records, so split the period. Choose the condition from 「チェックイン」 (Check-in) (default), 「利用日」 (Usage date) or 「チェックアウト」 (Check-out). 「利用日」 (Usage date) covers reservations staying during the period, excluding the check-out day and day use (example: arriving 7/8 and leaving 7/10 covers 7/8 and 7/9). It shows the scheduled and actual check-in and check-out times, nationality, name, address, occupation, passport number, previous place of stay, next destination, and more.

heading: Reservation CSV (per reservation / per room)
text: Both cover reservations whose check-in date is within the period. 「予約単位」 (Per reservation) has one row per reservation, and 「部屋単位」 (Per room) has one row per room per night (2 rooms for 3 nights gives 6 rows). They show nationality, breakdown of guests, booking channel, amounts by charge item and by payment method, prepaid and pay-at-the-hotel amounts, requests, operator memos, and more (per room also includes OTA commissions). Amounts are, as a rule, excluding tax. If you set the per-reservation period to today only, you can use it as a list of reservations checking in today. You cannot output only cancellations. Output with 「キャンセルを含む」 (Include cancellations), then look at the canceled rows.

heading: Guest information list
text: 予約管理 → 宿泊者情報 (Reservation management → Guest information) lists name, property, check-in code, booking channel, dates and contact information, and 「詳細を見る」 (View details) opens the guest details. You can also open them by clicking the name in 〖宿泊者情報〗 (Guest information) in the reservation details. Content entered on My Page can also be seen here (past reservations too). After correcting the guest details, press 「変更を保存する」 (Save changes). Only the guest can enter the signature and the form memo. You cannot filter by age group or similar, so if needed, output a CSV and process it. Companion information can be deleted from the reservation details, and the lead guest's information is deleted when the reservation is deleted. The manual says the data remains for the contract period and that registered images cannot be deleted (replace them with a blank image).

heading: Income and expenditure results report
text: In 売上管理 → 収支実績報告書 (Sales management → Income and expenditure results report), choose a property (one at a time) and a period (up to 3 months) to see sales, expenses, payments and advance payments received. Only properties using daily closing are totaled. Totals are calculated automatically after closing. Sales and payments are finalized with their contents at that time and are not recalculated if corrected later. Only expense entries (monthly) and advance payments received are totaled with the latest contents each time you open it. You can choose only days whose totals are finished. Sales are excluding tax and count on the usage date (or the check-out date if there is none). Tax, charges not counted as sales and point use are not included, nor are the amounts of canceled reservations. Payments that do not become receivables, such as cash, are counted on the payment date, and payments linked to an accounts receivable party (booking channel, card, etc.) are counted on the starting date set in the accounts receivable settings. The payment information CSV counts by payment date, so the amounts may not match even for the same period. When numbers do not match between reportsEach report handles cancellations, points, tax and non-reservation items differently, and counts by different dates (usage date, payment date, starting date). First check When report numbers do not match.

heading: 1. Search for a reservation
text: Left menu → 予約管理 (Reservation management) → 予約情報 (Reservation information)

heading: First use 「スマート予約検索」 (Smart reservation search) at the top
text: Enter one item you are sure of: name, furigana (phonetic reading), phone number, reservation number or check-in code. When candidates appear, also match one more item: stay date, number of guests or phone number. Open 「詳細」 (Details) for the correct reservation. Checkboxes next to the search box (from the official manual)By default, Smart reservation search only looks for reservations with check-out today or later. To find past reservations, tick 「過去分も表示」 (Show past ones too) next to the search box. To narrow to reservations leaving today, tick 「本日チェックアウト」 (Check-out today). For the match method, 「前方一致」 (Starts with) is recommended (with 「部分一致」 (Contains), for example, searching 「山田」 (Yamada) also brings up 「山本」 (Yamamoto) and 「田中」 (Tanaka)). What Smart reservation search can find (from the official manual)Besides name, phone number and check-in code, you can also search by booking channel, rate plan, room type, room number, corporate/group name and company name. The text of guest requests, operator memos, repeat memos and cleaning notes is also searched. Names and phone numbers are searched with hyphens, spaces and commas removed. Uppercase and lowercase letters, and hiragana and katakana, are not distinguished. You can also search with the keyword left empty (not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). Result of entering a name (example: テスト三郎) in 「スマート予約検索」 (Smart reservation search). Matching reservations appear in the 【予約情報】 (Reservation information) list.

heading: To narrow down from the list
text: Open 「条件を選択して絞り込み」 (Select conditions to filter). Set the check-in and check-out dates a little wider than the period you are looking for. Only if needed, also choose conditions such as cancellation status, room assignment status and occupancy status (「過去分も表示」 (Show past ones too) and 「本日チェックアウト」 (Check-out today) are not in the filter panel; they are next to Smart reservation search at the top). Change the sort order to one that fits your purpose, such as 「チェックイン（昇順）」 (Check-in, ascending). Match the representative's name, check-in code, stay dates, room name, booking channel and stay status. The 「条件を設定してください」 (Please set conditions) panel that opens from 「条件を選択して絞り込み」 (Select conditions to filter). Choose conditions such as room assignment status and enter a period such as check-in (without a period, the list is not shown). What was checked on the real screenThe reservation list shows: property name, representative's name, check-in code, in/out, number of nights, room name, memo, booking channel, stay status, last updated, and details. Conditions you can filter by (from the official manual) Besides check-in and check-out, you can filter by reservation received date (including the date imported from the site controller) and reservation updated date. You can also filter by occupancy status (provisional / not checked in / staying / checked out), repeat status and overbooking. For cancellations, you can choose 「キャンセルも表示する」 (Also show cancellations) or 「キャンセルのみ表示する」 (Show cancellations only). Name, check-in code, phone number, email address, company name, representative's name and group name are searched as "starts with"; OTA reservation numbers are searched as "contains". The default sort order is earliest check-in date first. The conditions shown at first (check-in from today to one month ahead) cannot be changed. To search by room number, use Smart reservation search at the top. (not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel) Meaning of the marks in the reservation list (from the official manual; not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel) Column How to read it マイページ (My Page) Press it to show a QR code; scanning it opens that guest's My Page メモ (Memo) Reservations with a request, operator memo or repeat memo show a memo mark; reservations where the guest asked for a receipt on My Page show a receipt mark. Press it to see the contents チェックインコード (Check-in code) A 6-digit number assigned automatically to each reservation. The guest enters it when checking in on the tablet 代表者名（人数） (Representative's name (guests)) An icon appears on reservations where My Page input is complete. Repeat guests show a light-blue face mark; reservations that may be repeat guests show a ⚠ mark and red text (Repeat guest check) 部屋番号 (Room number) Reservations with a key number show a key mark; reservations with a rate plan show a memo mark (press it to see the plan name). Before room assignment, 「（未部屋割り）」 (unassigned) is shown 予定入退室時間 (Planned in/out time) Reservations checking in today have an orange dot ステータス (Status) Press it to see the sending status of the My Page and check-in code emails, check-in status, cancellation status, and confirmed / provisional reservation. 「–」 means no email has been sent and the status has not changed yet If you can't find itAlso check different kanji/kana for the name, the representative's name, nearby dates, cancelled reservations and group reservations. The official manual points out the following. Filter search does not show cancelled reservations unless you choose a cancellation status. Choose 「キャンセルも表示する」 (Also show cancellations). By default, the reservation information list is limited to "check-in from today to one month ahead" (you can set a period of up to 1 year). By default, Smart reservation search does not show past reservations. Tick 「過去分も表示」 (Show past ones too). Smart reservation search can also find companions' names (not only the representative) and OTA reservation numbers. If you still can't find it, go to Reservation not found. Check before openingTo avoid guests with the same name, always also match one of: stay date, phone number or number of guests. For detailed steps, see Front operations (detailed steps): Finding a reservation

heading: 2. Register an individual reservation
text: 予約管理 (Reservation management) → 予約情報 (Reservation information) → 新規予約 (New reservation) Check that 「物件名」 (Property name) is correct (Araki Hotel has two properties: 「種子島あらきホテル」 (Tanegashima Araki Hotel) and 「種子島あらき別館」 (Tanegashima Araki Annex)). Enter the stay date and number of nights. Choose the number of adults and children, the room type and the number of rooms. Enter the guest's name, furigana (phonetic reading) and phone number. Check the rate plan, charges and payment method. If there are special notes, enter them in a short sentence anyone can understand. Read through the contents and press 「保存」 (Save) only once. The new reservation form (Tanegashima Araki Hotel). This example was opened from the room status chart (it opens in a new tab), so the date and room (1 night from 10/9 to 10/10, シングルB (Single B), 1 room, 1 guest) are already filled in. Forgetting or choosing the wrong property nameAccording to the official manual, you cannot save unless you choose a property name (the save button does not appear). Also watch out for choosing the wrong property, such as creating an annex reservation under the main building. Unconfirmed reservations are 「仮予約」 (provisional reservations) (from the official manual)A reservation that is not yet confirmed can be registered by ticking 「仮予約にする」 (Make provisional). While it is provisional, automatic emails are not sent and it is not counted in some reports. Untick it once confirmed (see Front operations for details; not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). Prevent duplicate registrationEven if the response is slow after saving, do not press repeatedly. Check in the reservation list whether it was registered before trying again. For detailed steps, see Front operations (detailed steps): 2. Creating a reservation (individual reservation)

heading: 3. Register a group reservation
text: 予約管理 (Reservation management) → 予約情報 (Reservation information) → 新規予約 (New reservation) → 宿泊変更 (Change stay) There is no separate entry point for group reservations. In the same 「新規予約」 (New reservation) screen as individual reservations, set multiple rooms and multiple guests. In 「代表者情報」 (Representative information), enter the group representative's name and contact details. In 「予約情報」 (Reservation information), enter the basic conditions such as stay dates and rate plan. In 「人数変更」 (Change number of guests) under 「宿泊変更」 (Change stay), set the number of rooms per room type and the number of guests in each room. In 「金額変更」 (Change amount), check the charges per room and per day, and change them only if needed, following the rules of the manager (person in charge). If you decide room numbers at the time of reservation, assign them in 「部屋変更」 (Change room). In 「宿泊者情報」 (Guest information), check which guest is in which room. Record who pays, the billing address and any undecided items in 「共有事項」 (Shared notes), check the booking channel and the reservation received date and time, and save. In 「人数変更」 (Change number of guests) under 「宿泊変更」 (Change stay), the room type is set to ツイン (Twin), the number of rooms to 2 and guests per room to 1. The total is shown as 「部屋：2 人数：2」 (Rooms: 2, Guests: 2). Reservation details after pressing 「予約を登録する」 (Register reservation). It is registered with 2 rooms (Twin 414 and 417) and 2 guests, and the 「予約を分割」 (Split reservation) button appears at the top right. Difference from an individual reservationThe entry point and screen are the same. The difference is that you set multiple rooms, guests, charges and room numbers in 「宿泊変更」 (Change stay). Do not finish after registering only the representative. Read it back before savingCheck the whole group's stay dates, number of rooms, number of guests and charges, and the guest assignment for each room. For detailed steps, see Front operations (detailed steps): 3. Creating a reservation (group reservation)

heading: 4. Change a reservation
text: Check 「予約経路」 (Booking channel) in the reservation details. For phone or direct reservations, check the change and the difference in charges, and edit it in the PMS. For reservations via an OTA or travel agency, as a rule, change it at the source and wait for the sync. Read back the dates, number of guests, room and charges after the change. If the room or dates changed, share it with the cleaning staff and the next shift. The 「宿泊変更」 (Change stay) → 「部屋変更」 (Change room) screen in reservation details. The room for each night is listed by date (in this example, 401 for both nights, 10/20 and 10/21). Change dates, number of guests and rooms from 「宿泊変更」 (Change stay). Do not change external reservations only in the PMSAccording to the official PDF, reservations via the site controller are, as a rule, changed on the booking site side. If you change only the PMS, a later automatic update may revert it, and inventory or charges may get out of sync. According to the official manual, for imported reservations the date/time, rate plan, number of rooms, number of guests, charges and payment cannot be changed from the admin screen. Stopping automatic updates is the manager's decisionIf you stop automatic updates for a reservation, later changes are no longer synced. If you cannot confirm the reason, the target reservation and the conditions for lifting it, do not do it. Inventory is sent automatically from HOTEL SMART to TL-LincolnAccording to the official manual, when you change dates, inventory must be adjusted on the site controller side unless the connection with the site controller is "2way". Araki Hotel uses two-way integration with TL-Lincoln, so when you change dates or the number of rooms in the PMS, cancel a reservation, or block a room, inventory is sent automatically from HOTEL SMART's 【販売在庫】 (Sales inventory) to TL-Lincoln (it can take up to 15 minutes to be reflected). Even if you fix remaining rooms by hand on the TL-Lincoln screen, it will be overwritten, so the manager adjusts inventory on the HOTEL SMART side (from the official manual; see Front operations for details, and for settings, Initial setup: "Sales inventory"). For detailed steps, see Front operations (detailed steps): 4. Changing a reservation (by pattern)

heading: 5. Register charges and take payment
text: Reservation details → 料金・精算情報 (Charges and payment information) Check that the room charge, extra charges and discounts are correct. Check the payment terms, such as prepaid, pay at the hotel or invoice. Enter the amount received and the payment method. Check that the outstanding balance is 0 yen, or that the billing address is correct. Match the total on screen against the actual cash and card slips. The 《新規料金情報》 (New charge information) input screen. When you enter the charge item, date of use, room, unit price and so on, the subtotal is calculated automatically. After entering, press 「保存する」 (Save). The 「一括精算」 (Bulk payment) input screen. Specify the payment method (prepaid / pay at the hotel), type, points and payment date, and press 「精算する」 (Settle). What looks different What to check Higher or lower than the reservation confirmation Check the number of guests, number of nights, extra charges, discounts and tax Shows unpaid even though it is prepaid Check the booking channel and payment information, and do not charge twice Cash does not match Do not change amounts to make it match; check the transaction history and the actual cash with the manager Cancellations and refunds after payment go to the managerUntil the correct way to fix it is confirmed, do not add an opposite amount or move it to another payment method on your own judgment. For detailed steps, see Front operations (detailed steps): 5. Registering charge information (sales) / 6. Registering payment information Rooms with an outstanding balance can be listed in 【売上管理】 (Sales management) → 【滞在中精算チェックリスト】 (In-house payment checklist) (for details, see Front operations (detailed steps)). For payment using a corporate or group advance payment (「前受金の取り崩し」 (Draw down advance payment)), payment billed later (「後日決済」 (Pay later)), and registering receipts of accounts receivable, see Front operations: "Corporate/group advance payments and receivables (pay later)" (from the official manual).

heading: 6. Issue a receipt
text: Reservation details → 利用明細・領収書 (Statement and receipt) Check the receipt amount and that it has been paid. Create it after registering the payment (according to the official manual, the purpose line can only be entered when there is a receipt amount; if you create it before payment, it becomes a statement only). Confirm the addressee and the purpose line with the guest. Issue the receipt and open the created PDF. Check the date, addressee, amount and purpose line, then print. The 《利用明細・領収書》 (Statement and receipt) section in reservation details. Choose the target room and press 「明細・領収書作成」 (Create statement/receipt). The 「プラン仕訳料金を統合する」 (Combine plan breakdown charges) and 「領収項目に絞る」 (Limit to receipt items) checkboxes and the history of issued documents are listed. The 《利用明細・領収書作成》 (Create statement and receipt) screen. Check the language setting, tax category, addressee, arrival/departure dates, item details, receipt amount and purpose line, then press 「発行する」 (Issue). What the issued statement and receipt (PDF) looks like (example screen from the official manual; a report from a demo property). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル (official online manual, in Japanese)) The downloaded PDF opened in the browser. Print from the print icon at the top right (red frame) (example screen from the official manual; a demo property's screen). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル (official online manual, in Japanese)) Do not issue for amounts prepaid on the booking siteAccording to the official manual, HOTEL SMART issues receipts for amounts paid at the hotel, and for amounts prepaid on the booking site, the guest gets the receipt from the booking site. To prevent duplicate issuing, direct guests to the booking site's receipt for prepaid amounts (use 「領収項目に絞る」 (Limit to receipt items) as needed). Explanation in the official PDFDownload the receipt as a PDF and print it after checking the contents. When issuing a second time, follow the property's rules so it is clear that it is a reissue. How to know it's doneThe payment amount on screen, the receipt amount and the amount actually received all match. Guests who issue receipts on My Page (from the official manual)Araki Hotel uses the guest My Page. If receipt issuing on My Page is enabled, guests can issue a receipt themselves from My Page after check-out, entering the addressee. To avoid the front desk issuing the same receipt again, ask the guest whether they have issued one (the receipt issuing setting is not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel; see Front operations for details). For detailed steps, see Front operations (detailed steps): 7. Issuing statements and receipts

heading: 1. What is room assignment
text: At the time of booking, sometimes only the room type is decided, such as "1 twin room", and the specific room number is not yet set. Room assignment is the operation of assigning an actual room, such as "Room 203", to that reservation. Method When to use Who Manual assignment When you want to specify a particular room, or handle today's unassigned reservations Front desk / the manager (person in charge) Automatic room assignment Decides automatically at the set timing, based on room type and priority rules Settings are changed by the administrator Bulk floor assignment Reserving a whole floor in advance for a group, such as a school trip The manager only

heading: 2. Checks before assigning
text: The property name and displayed date are correct The reservation's stay dates, number of nights and number of guests are correct The reservation's room type matches the type of the room you assign The room's capacity is not exceeded There is no other reservation or room block in the same period Cleaning can be finished by the arrival time No unintended room move happens partway through a multi-night stay You have checked requests such as non-smoking, floor and adjacent rooms, and the shared notes Don't decide right away even if it looks freeThere are cases you cannot judge from the list alone, such as cleaning in progress, planned repairs, overlapping times with the reservations before and after, or the middle of a multi-night stay.

heading: 3. Assign manually from reservation details
text: Method A: Choose in 「部屋割り当て」 (Room assignment) in reservation details (same room for the whole stay) 予約管理 (Reservation management) → 予約情報 (Reservation information) → details of the target reservation → 部屋割り当て (Room assignment) The official manual (online version) explains these separately: the room for the whole stay is chosen in ［部屋割り当て］ (Room assignment) in reservation details, and 「部屋変更」 (Change room) in 「宿泊変更」 (Change stay) is used only when changing rooms by day. In ［部屋割り当て］ (Room assignment), choose a room number for each room or press 「おまかせ割り当て」 (Auto-assign for me). 「おまかせ割り当て」 (Auto-assign for me) assigns rooms following the automatic room assignment settings (rotation and priority) (the official text calls it 「おまかせ選択」 (Auto-select for me)). On the Araki Hotel screen too, we have confirmed that the 「おまかせ割り当て」 (Auto-assign for me) button appears for rooms with no room number entered (Adding/removing rooms, checked 2026-10-05). How to save after choosing a room number is not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel. Even for a multi-night stay, the same room is entered for all days, so this method makes missed entries less likely. The ［部屋割り当て］ (Room assignment) section in reservation details. For each room, choose a room number or press 「おまかせ割り当て」 (Auto-assign for me). 「全部屋おまかせ割り当て」 (Auto-assign all rooms) at the top right fills them all at once. Assigned rooms show a room change button (example screen from the official manual; a demo property's screen). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル (official online manual, in Japanese)) Method B: Choose by day in 「宿泊変更」 (Change stay) → 「部屋変更」 (Change room) (change rooms by day / assign only some days) This is the procedure confirmed in the official front operations PDF. It is also used for group reservations and multi-room reservations. 予約管理 (Reservation management) → 予約情報 (Reservation information) → details of the target reservation → 宿泊変更 (Change stay) → 部屋変更 (Change room) Open the target reservation and match the name, stay dates and number of guests. Open 「部屋変更」 (Change room) in 「宿泊変更」 (Change stay). Click the 「未割当」 (Unassigned) cell for the date to assign. From the dropdown, choose a room number that matches the booked room type. For a multi-night stay, check that all dates have the same room. In the guest register, also check which guest is in which room. Save the reservation, open the reservation details again and check the room number. Group reservationsCheck not only the representative but also the number of guests and the guest assignment for each room. When only certain rooms have different dates, 「日程削除」 (Delete dates) is sometimes used, but it is not used for normal room assignment. How to know it's doneThe correct room number is shown for every stay date in the reservation details, and nothing is left unassigned. Method C: Assign from the room status chart (reservations arriving that day) The official manual describes a way to assign unassigned reservations directly from the room status chart (not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). On the room status chart, press a room with a speech-bubble icon (a reservation is available to assign). Press 「未部屋割りの予約を割り当てる」 (Assign an unassigned reservation) and choose the reservation to assign. Press 「割り当てる」 (Assign). When you press a vacant room with a speech-bubble icon in the left image, the 「未部屋割りの予約を割り当てる」 (Assign an unassigned reservation) dropdown and the 「割り当てる」 (Assign) button appear in the details, as in the right image (example screen from the official manual; a demo property's screen). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル (official online manual, in Japanese))

heading: 4. Check unassigned reservations in 「部屋割り表」 (Room allocation chart)
text: 予約管理 (Reservation management) → 部屋割り表 (Room allocation chart) On the real screen, the following items were confirmed. Property selection 2-week view / base-date view, changing the base date 「未部屋割り一覧」 (Unassigned list) and the unassigned count Schedule bar, room type, representative / number of guests, number of rooms, booking channel, period of use Group and with-children indicators, filter mode Room assignment status chart, multiple reservations, blocked, floor filter 「自動割当」 (Auto-assign) button When there are unassigned reservations, they are listed one per row in 「未部屋割り一覧」 (Unassigned list), and the count appears at the top right, such as 「未割当数：14件」 (Unassigned: 14) (checked 2026-10-09). The columns are: schedule bar / room type / representative / number of guests / rooms / total rooms / booking channel / period of use / auto-assign (a button on each row). The 「未部屋割り一覧」 (Unassigned list) on the room allocation chart. 「未割当数：14件」 (Unassigned: 14) is shown at the top right, and each reservation is listed on its own row. 「自動割当」 (Auto-assign) on each row: When you press 「自動割当」 (Auto-assign) on the right of a row in the Unassigned list, the 「自動割り当て」 (Automatic assignment) confirmation screen opens, showing the stay period, representative's name, specified room type and the room number to be assigned (example: 417（ツイン） (417, Twin)). Pressing 「割当をする」 (Assign) assigns it immediately and the screen reloads (no separate save is needed) (checked 2026-10-09). The 「自動割り当て」 (Automatic assignment) confirmation screen that opens from 「自動割当」 (Auto-assign) on a row. The stay period, representative's name, specified room type and the room number to be assigned (417（ツイン） (417, Twin) in this example) are shown. 「自動割当」 (Auto-assign) at the top right (all): When pressed, all unassigned reservations that cover the displayed base date are listed, and you can check the room numbers to be assigned. 「割当をする」 (Assign) assigns them all at once. Those that cannot be assigned show 「割り当てられる部屋がありません」 (No room available to assign) and stay unassigned. Example: running it with base date 10/10 included a 1-night reservation from 10/9 to 10/10 and a long-term reservation from 10/1 to 11/1, and rooms were assigned to 13 of 15 reservations (checked 2026-10-09). Long-term reservations covering that day are assigned too「自動割当」 (Auto-assign) at the top right assigns not only the displayed day but also long-term reservations that cover that day, all at once. Always check the rooms to be assigned in the list before pressing it. The confirmation screen opened by 「自動割当」 (Auto-assign) at the top right (top part). Unassigned reservations covering the base date are listed, and you can check the room numbers to be assigned. Confirmation screen (bottom part). Reservations that cannot be assigned show 「割り当てられる部屋がありません」 (No room available to assign). 「割当をする」 (Assign) assigns them all at once. The room allocation chart after running it. Only the reservations that could not be assigned remain, and the unassigned count became 2. Assigning by dragging is awaiting confirmationDragging the schedule bar had no effect, and in this check the reservation was not assigned (checked 2026-10-09). The correct way to do it is awaiting confirmation, so it is not an official procedure. Regular staff should use "Assign manually from reservation details" above. The official manual (an article on arranged-item management) describes dragging and dropping an already assigned reservation on the room assignment screen to move it to another vacant room (it says no confirmation screen appears). The official manual also says nothing about dragging from the Unassigned list into a room. It may not have worked this time because we tried to move an unassigned row. The representative column of the room allocation chart is shown in furigana (katakana reading) (example: タネガシマサトトキ) (checked 2026-10-09).

heading: 5. How automatic room assignment works
text: 物件管理 (Property management) → 物件情報 (Property information) → 詳細を見る (View details) → 自動部屋割り設定 (Automatic room assignment settings) Settings changed by administrator only Choose the timing for automatic room assignment, in a range from the check-in day to 90 days before. As needed, set rotation room assignment and a priority for each room. When the set timing arrives, rooms are assigned by the daily batch from around 1:00 a.m. Reservations that come in after the assignment timing has passed are assigned immediately. After assignment, check the result in 「部屋割り表」 (Room allocation chart) or the reservation details. Official recommendation for properties with multiple rooms「当日チェックインの予約のみ実行」 (Run only for same-day check-in reservations) is recommended. Assigning too early can cause room moves in multi-night reservations, or stop room type changes from the OTA from being reflected.

heading: Assignment order

heading: Confirmed
text: The 「自動割当」 (Auto-assign) button on the room allocation chart, when pressed, assigns unassigned reservations covering the base date, with a confirmation screen. Check the rooms that are 「チェックイン予定」 (Arriving), 「宿泊中」 (In house), 「チェックアウト待ち」 (Awaiting check-out), 「清掃待ち」 (Awaiting cleaning) / 「清掃中」 (Cleaning), 「空室」 (Vacant), and 「ブロック中」 (Blocked). (These are the status names on the screen. For their meaning and icons, see the table in Daily tasks: "Check room status".) If there are 1 or more, assign them in the 「未部屋割り一覧」 (Unassigned list) of the room allocation chart (from the official manual; rooms that are candidates for assignment show a speech-bubble icon). Tell the cleaning staff about rooms that are still uncleaned with an arrival time coming up soon. Layout of the room status chart. The status list on the left also shows the count of 「未部屋割りの予約」 (Unassigned reservations) (screen example from the official manual; a demo property's screen). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル, official online manual, in Japanese) Do not judge by color aloneAlways read the room number, guest name, stay dates, and the status name shown on the screen. If you cannot find an arriving guest on the status chart, check the cleaning schedule first (not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). No-show rooms also become 「清掃待ち」 (Awaiting cleaning) on the cleaning day. Whether a cleaning report needs 「承認」 (Approval) depends on 「請求条件」 (Billing condition) under ［清掃管理］→［手配設定］ (Cleaning management → Arrangement settings) → the property's 「詳細を見る」 (View details). If it is set to 「確認が完了しているもののみ」 (Only those confirmed), same-day arrival reservations do not appear until the cleaning report is confirmed (approved). If it is 「清掃報告されている全て」 (All reported cleanings), no approval is needed (from the official manual; Araki Hotel's billing condition setting is not yet confirmed). Numbers at the top of the screen (from the official manual)The occupancy rate at the top of the screen is the number of rooms with a reservation that includes that day's scheduled check-in time, divided by the total number of rooms. In the status list on the left, one room can be counted under more than one status, so the counts may add up to more than the number of rooms. The size of the room tiles cannot be changed (use full-screen mode to see them larger). Not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel. Get the completion report from the cleaning staff. Read the room number back once more, then register the cleaning as complete. Press 「一括操作」 (Bulk actions) at the top right, and an action bar (未手配を全選択 (Select all unarranged) / 手配する (Arrange) / 完了する (Complete) / 確認する (Confirm)) appears at the bottom of the screen. Go back to the room status chart and check that the rooms with arrivals are ready for guests. heading: Cleaning management operating patterns
text: The official manual organizes how cleaning management is used along three points: "share schedules as PDF (paper) or online," "managed by facility staff or by a cleaning company," and "share schedules only, also manage progress, or also keep reports with photos (evidence)," and divides them into the following patterns. If you choose online sharing, cleaners see their schedules on their own screens and can send completion reports and detailed reports. Pattern How it is shared Who manages it A Shared as PDF (printed). Paper-based; progress is not managed in the system Facility B–D Shared online (B: schedules only / C: also progress such as in cleaning and complete / D: also reports with photos and details) Facility staff E–G Shared online (the differences among E–G are the same as B–D) External cleaning company Araki Hotel's current setupNo cleaning organizations or cleaners are registered, so operations are close to pattern A. The difference is that the front desk presses 「完了する」 (Complete) in the cleaning schedule after receiving the cleaning staff's report (based on the state of the screens checked on 2026-10-09). The manager decides whether to switch to the cleaner app (B–D).

heading: 3. A guest in house moves to another room
text: Open the guest's reservation details and check the date of the move. Check that the destination room is vacant, cleaned, and not blocked. Change the room assignment from the move date onward. Check that the stay dates, old room, new room, and charges are as intended, then save. Exchange the keys and collect the key to the old room. Share the old room, new room, and move date with the cleaning staff and the next shift. Use the right one of two methodsTo swap the room for the whole stay (the room was not cleaned at arrival, equipment broke, etc.), use 「ルームチェンジ」 (Room change) (Room change). To move to another room partway through a multi-night stay, use 「宿泊変更」 (Change stay) → 「部屋変更」 (Change room) to change the room from the move date onward (Changing rooms mid-stay). Do not re-create the reservationAccording to the official manual (PDF and online versions), a room move partway through a multi-night stay is done from 「宿泊変更」 (Change stay) within the reservation. Creating a separate reservation splits the charges, guests, and payment, so do not re-create it on your own judgment.

heading: 4. Block a room
text: Use this to stop sales and assignment for a room because of a breakdown, repairs, in-house use, etc. 物件管理 → 部屋情報 → the room's 「詳細を見る」 → ブロック設定 (Property management → Room info → View details → Block settings) Check the room number, start date and time, and end date and time. To stop one night, make the period span 0:00 of the next day (e.g. 15:00 that day to 11:00 the next day). According to the official manual, if 0:00 of the next day falls within the block period, that day is treated as blocked and inventory is reduced. Check that there are no reservations in the same period. In 〖ブロック設定〗 (Block settings) on the room details, press 「ブロック期間を追加する」 (Add block period), select the period, and press 「OK」. Write the reason (such as a breakdown) and the planned release in the memo field (the memo is shown on the room status chart and room allocation chart in place of the guest name). Press 「変更を保存する」 (Save changes) to register it. On the room status chart, check that the period is now purple and shows 「ブロック中」 (Blocked). Leave "room, reason, period, and who decides the release" in the handover. 〖ブロック設定〗 (Block settings) on the room details. Enter a period and memo (e.g. air conditioner broken) on each row. Delete a row with its 「×」, and add a row with 「ブロック期間を追加する」 (Add block period) (screen example from the official manual; a demo property's screen). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル, official online manual, in Japanese) Step 5: Room status chart (10/27). The blocked room 403 is purple and shows 「ブロック中」 (Blocked) with its memo, and 「ブロック中」 (Blocked) on the left shows 1 room. To release it, press the row's 「×」 in the same 〖ブロック設定〗 (Block settings), then press 「変更を保存する」 (Save changes). For detailed steps with screenshots, see Blocking a room and Release a block (checked 2026-10-07). Blocks on closed dates cannot be changed or deletedAccording to the official manual, blocks on dates for which daily closing is done can be neither changed nor deleted. "Cannot be set for a period with reservations" is stated in the official PDF, is not in the online version, and has not been confirmed on Araki Hotel's real screen either. In either case, do not move reservations on your own or force the registration by changing the period; consult the manager.

heading: Features not currently used at Araki Hotel
text: Meal management is not used in normal work, because Araki Hotel does not currently serve meals. If you open it by mistakeDo not register or change anything on the meal status chart or meal location screens; go back to the screen you need from the left menu. heading: What to do first
text: Note the guest's name, the dates concerned, and the reservation number. Before dismissing a message on the screen, write down its wording or take a photo of the screen. Note what you pressed just before, and the operation right before that. Do not press the same button repeatedly; go to the steps for the symptom below. Do notDo not force amounts to match, re-create the same reservation, rewrite an external reservation only in the PMS, or stop automatic integration without knowing why.

heading: Reservation not found
text: If you cannot find it on the room status chart, it may be a reservation with no room decided (unassigned). Unassigned reservations do not appear in the rooms on the status chart, so search in 予約管理 → 予約情報 (Reservation management → Reservation info) (from the official manual). Widen the date range by about one month before and after. By default, the reservation info list is narrowed to "check-in from today to one month ahead" (from the official manual). Search by name in kanji, in kana, and by family name only. Also search by phone number, reservation number, and lead guest name. Smart reservation search can also find companions' names and OTA reservation numbers. 「当日分の予約検索」 (Search today's reservations) on the status chart can search by group name, the name and furigana of the lead guest or guests, OTA reservation number, and room name (from the official manual). Also check canceled reservations, group reservations, and reservations for other properties. Canceled reservations do not appear unless you select 「キャンセルも表示する」 (Also show cancellations) in the filter (Search for a reservation). Check in the OTA's admin screen or the reservation notification that the booking was completed and for which property. If it exists externally but not in the PMS, do not register it twice; contact the manager. The panel that opens from 「条件を選択して絞り込み」 (Filter by conditions) in 予約管理 → 予約情報 (Reservation management → Reservation info). The list is not shown unless you enter a period such as check-in (the period must be within one year). If the guest is in front of you on the dayAsk to see the reservation confirmation email, and note the stay dates, number of guests, payment, and reservation number. Get the manager's decision before promising a vacant room.

heading: Cannot check in
text: Where to check What to look for What to do Reservation status Canceled, already in house, wrong date Recheck that it is the right reservation Room Unassigned, overlaps another reservation, blocked Do not release it on your own; contact the manager Cleaning Not cleaned / cleaning in progress Check the actual state with the cleaning staff Payment Not settled, prepaid payment not reflected Do not charge twice; check the booking channel Required information Name, number of guests, etc. not entered Confirm the facts and enter them The details that open when you click a room on the room status chart. You can check guest info and stay info (stay period, number of guests, room), and there are 「チェックイン」 (Check in), 「ルームチェンジ」 (Room change), and 「予約詳細」 (Reservation details) buttons.

heading: An error appeared on the check-in tablet
text: Messages shown when a guest cannot check in on the tablet, and what to do (from the official manual; the message wording is not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). For the guest's steps, see Tablet self check-in. Tablet message Cause What to do チェックイン可能時間前です (It is before the check-in time) The reservation's check-in time (or the early check-in time, if set) has not been reached Ask the guest to wait until that time, or check them in at the front desk at the manager's decision 予約に部屋が割り当てられていません。施設管理者にご連絡下さい。 (No room is assigned to the reservation. Please contact the property manager.) No room is decided for the reservation (unassigned) Select a room in the reservation details and save (Room assignment), then ask the guest to go through the tablet again チェックインコードが不正です (The check-in code is invalid) The code was mistyped, or it is the code of a reservation whose check-in date is not today Search for the reservation and check the check-in code and stay dates. If the date differs, check the reservation details A passport or face photo cannot be taken: ask the guest to retake it so that exactly one face is clearly shown. Other documents are not checked for a face. Which fields the guest is asked to fill in is set in 〖お客様情報入力〗 (Guest information entry) in the tablet display settings. Fields already filled in on the guest My Page can be skipped on the tablet. Changing the settings is done by the administrator (Guest information entry). The guest wants to split the payment: this cannot be done on the tablet, so settle the payment at the front desk.

heading: Cannot save / an error appeared
text: Check fields with a red frame or a 「必須」 (Required) mark. Check the order of dates, the number of guests against room capacity, and the phone number format. Check for error text at the top and bottom of the screen. Save only once and wait for a response. If it does not improve, record the error text, the time, the reservation concerned, and the steps you took. Before contacting, check on another screen that the reservation has not already been created or updated. Before closing the browserRecord what you entered and the error. Logging in again may fix it, but if you close first, the cause and what you entered will be lost.

heading: The reservation amount differs from the amount on screen
text: Check the stay dates, number of nights, number of guests, and room type. Check additional charges, discounts, and tax and service charges. Check the booking channel and whether it is prepaid. Check the amounts in the change history and the reservation notification. If you cannot explain the reason for the difference, do not charge or refund; contact the manager. For administrators: when a prepaid reservation shows 「未払い」 (Unpaid)The official manual names a possible cause: under 「設定」 (Settings) at the bottom left of the screen → 「宿泊予約サイト手数料設定」 (Booking site fee settings), ［現地払い］ (Pay at the hotel) may be checked for that payment method. The front desk does not charge twice and passes it to the manager, and the manager or administrator checks this setting (not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). 「設定」 (Settings) at the bottom left of the screen → 「宿泊予約サイト手数料設定」 (Booking site fee settings). Each payment method has a ［現地払い］ (Pay at the hotel) checkbox; save with 「現地払い設定を更新する」 (Update pay-at-hotel settings) (screen example from the official manual; a demo property's screen). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル, official online manual, in Japanese) The 《料金・精算情報》 (Charges and payment info) section of the reservation details. It shows 利用総額 (Total usage), 総支払額 (Total paid), and 未収金 (Outstanding balance) (in this example, only part has been paid, with an outstanding balance of ¥5,000). Check the breakdown in 《料金詳細》 (Charge details) and 《支払い情報》 (Payment info) below.

heading: The OTA reservation differs from the PMS
text: Steps for when the stay dates, number of guests, room, charges, cancellation status, etc. differ. Check that the reservation number in the PMS and the one on the OTA or site controller side are the same. Check the last updated date and time on each. Note exactly which items differ. Do not correct only the PMS side; contact the manager. After checking where the change came from and the integration status, correct it on the screen you are told to use. Do not stop automatic updates on your own judgmentAfter stopping, changes made externally are not reflected. Also, when it is restarted, what you corrected in the PMS may be reverted. Main reasons OTA-side changes do not come in (from the official manual) Changes that arrive while automatic updates are stopped are not imported, even if you restart later. Some changes are not imported into reservations that are checked in or whose daily closing is done. In either case, look at the OTA-side details and enter them by hand as the manager instructs (Stopping site controller automatic updates). Not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel.

heading: You made a mistake / may have made a mistake
text: Operation What to do on the spot What not to do Pressed save repeatedly Check the reservation list for duplicates of the same reservation Do not create yet another new reservation Wrong check-in / check-out Record the time, reservation, and displayed status, and contact the manager Do not create a separate reservation to make things balance Settled a wrong amount Preserve the amount, payment method, and slip, and contact the manager Do not add the opposite amount on your own Wrong room assignment Check the old room, new room, cleaning status, and keys Do not change an in-house guest's room without permission Changed an external reservation Record the changed items and update time, and check the integration Do not repeatedly stop and restart automatic updates How to undo (from the official manual) Before daily closing: A wrong payment can be removed by opening the row's 「詳細」 (Details) in 《支払い情報》 (Payment info) of the reservation details and pressing 「削除する」 (Delete). For charges that are already settled, remove the payment first and then correct them (Registering charge information). A wrong check-in / check-out can be undone from the status at the top right of the reservation details with 「チェックインを取り消す」 (Undo check-in) or 「チェックアウトを取り消す」 (Undo check-out). At properties that allow check-in by room, you can undo it room by room (Check-in by room). After daily closing: Charges and payments for a closed day can be neither changed nor deleted. Adjust them on a date that is not closed, or with 予約外_料金・精算 (Non-reservation charges and payments). The manager makes this adjustment (予約外_料金・精算 (Non-reservation charges and payments)). The menu that opens when you press the status at the top right of 〖代表者情報〗 (Lead guest information) in the reservation details. Undo with 「チェックインを取り消す」 (Undo check-in) (red frame) (screen example from the official manual; a demo property's screen). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル, official online manual, in Japanese) Who may undo is awaiting confirmation on siteThe methods are as above, but who may undo a wrong check-in / check-out, cancel a payment, or issue a refund (permissions) will be decided after checking with HOTEL SMART and the Araki Hotel manager. Until then, record things as in the table above and contact the manager.

heading: Emails do not reach the guest / cannot be sent
text: When a guest says an automatic email (reservation confirmation, check-in code, etc.) has not arrived, check the following in order (from the official manual; not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). Check that an email address is entered in the guest information in the reservation details. Emails cannot be sent for reservations from booking sites that do not pass on email addresses, such as Rakuten Travel and Ikyu (Automatic email delivery). Araki Hotel does not use SMS, so contact the guest by phone or through the booking site's messages. Check that the address is in a valid form. Emails cannot be sent to addresses with consecutive dots such as "..", a dot right before "@", or full-width characters mixed in. The send date and time for the automatic email may not have come yet. You can see when it was sent in ［付帯情報］ (Additional info) of the reservation details. Within one week, you can also see it in 「メール送信履歴」 (Email sending history) in the menu under the account name at the top right. If it was sent but has not arrived, possible causes are the spam folder, blocking on the receiving side, or delays on the receiving side. Ask the guest to check their spam folder. To resend by hand, use 「送信」 (Send) or 「再送」 (Resend) in ［付帯情報］ (Additional info) of the reservation details. These buttons send regardless of the automatic sending settings, so do not press them on test reservations. The link in the email does not open: the receiving side may disable links, or the URL may be broken across lines. Tell the guest to copy the whole URL and paste it into the browser. The sender is no-reply@hotelsmart.jp, which cannot receive replies. If the guest replies, it goes to the property's email address. The body of sent emails cannot be viewed in the system. If you want a copy, have a BCC set for each email (administrator). The check-in code email is sent at the set date and time even if the guest My Page entry is not finished. With the 「再送信を行う」 (Resend) setting, it is sent twice: when the entry is finished and at the set date and time. A different text than the settings arrived: templates are separate for (未選択) (Not selected), Japanese, English, Chinese, and Korean. Which language is sent depends on the language the guest chose on the guest My Page or tablet, so fix all of them (administrator). In Gmail, line breaks may not show. This cannot be fixed in the settings. Files can be attached to automatic emails. To stop emails to guests, set automatic sending of each email to 「行わない」 (Do not send) in the automatic email delivery settings (administrator).

heading: Numbers in reports or the dashboard do not match
text: Each report counts differently, so it is not unusual for numbers to differ. When you find a difference, first check whether it is explained by one of the differences below (from the official manual; not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). How to output reports is in Output reports and CSVs. Report / screen Day counted Included / excluded This month's actual sales on the dashboard Usage date (check-out date if none) Tax excluded. Includes non-reservation items, regardless of reservation status Occupancy output The selected day (divided at the 04:00 closing time) Includes reservations canceled later. Excludes point use, tax, items not counted as sales, and partial payments Payment info CSV Payment date Both reservations and non-reservation items. Refunds are deducted Income and expenditure report Sales by usage date; payments by payment date or the account receivable's starting date Tax excluded. Does not include tax, items not counted as sales, points, or canceled reservations. Finalized after closing and does not change even if corrected later Monthly totals in reports - Updated once a day. Check the totaling date and time at the top right The closing time is 04:00, so payments between midnight and before 4:00 go into the previous day (Daily closing).
