The date deletion screen has four options for what to delete: 「この日のみ」 (this day only), 「この日までの」 (up to this day), 「この日以降の」 (from this day on) and 「一連の日程」 (the whole series of dates); for a gap, choose 「この日のみ」 (this day only) (from the screen example in the official manual). Whether you first need to press 「割当解除」 (Unassign) has not been checked on the real screen at Araki Hotel. Screen example for shortening a stay / deleting dates (screen example from the official manual; a demo property's screen). In 「部屋変更」 (Change room), pressing 「削除」 (Delete) on a date column deletes that day for all rooms at once. (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル (official online manual, in Japanese)) You can also extend the check-out date from 「部屋変更」 (Change room) in 《宿泊変更》 (Change stay) (checked 2026-10-09). Press 「宿泊変更」 (Change stay) in 《予約情報》 (Reservation info) and open 「部屋変更」 (Change room). Press 「全部屋の日数を追加」 (Add days to all rooms) at the top right. On the 「宿泊日数追加」 (Add nights) screen, enter the number of days to add (default: 1 night). The screen showed 「全部屋に追加する日数を入力してください」 (Enter the number of days to add to all rooms) and 「※部屋料金には前日指定が反映されます」 (*The previous day's setting is applied to the room charge). Press 「追加する」 (Add). The same room is also set for the added days. Press 「保存」 (Save) to confirm. To extend room by room, use 「1部屋目のみ日数を追加」 (Add days to room 1 only) to the right of each row (we confirmed the button exists). In the example below, the same room (414) was also set for the added 10/24, and after saving the stay became 10/23 to 10/25, 2 nights (checked 2026-10-09). Steps 1–2: the 「宿泊変更」 (Change stay) → 「部屋変更」 (Change room) screen. 「全部屋の日数を追加」 (Add days to all rooms) is at the top right, and 「1部屋目のみ日数を追加」 (Add days to room 1 only) is to the right of the row. Step 3: the 「宿泊日数追加」 (Add nights) screen. It shows 「全部屋に追加する日数を入力してください」 (Enter the number of days to add to all rooms) and 「※部屋料金には前日指定が反映されます」 (*The previous day's setting is applied to the room charge), and the default number of days is 1 night. Step 4: after pressing 「追加する」 (Add). A 10/24 column has been added, with the same room (414). Step 5: reservation details after pressing 「保存」 (Save). The dates are now 10/23 to 10/25 (2 nights). Screen example for extending a stay (changing the check-out date) (screen example from the official manual; a demo property's screen). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル (official online manual, in Japanese)) Tip Typing numbers directly into a date field with the keyboard sometimes triggered a warning in reaction to the half-entered value (checked 2026-10-05). Changing the number of nights or choosing from the calendar is more reliable. Caution When you change the dates, also watch the inventory on the site controller side. According to the official manual, if the integration is not two-way, inventory must be adjusted in the site controller after a date change. Araki Hotel is connected to TL-Lincoln with two-way integration, so when you change dates or the number of rooms in HOTEL SMART, the inventory freed up or taken is sent automatically from HOTEL SMART to TL-Lincoln (up to 15 minutes to take effect). There is no need to fix inventory by hand on the TL-Lincoln side. For details, see "TL-Lincoln (two-way) and inventory" below; for the integration settings, see Initial setup, "TL-Lincoln integration". For a reservation with arranged items, moving the check-in date also shifts the arrangement dates by the same number of days (Scene 2, "Arranged items").

heading: TL-Lincoln (two-way) and inventory
text: Araki Hotel is connected to the site controller "TL-Lincoln" with two-way integration. With two-way integration, OTA reservations are not only imported; the inventory (rooms remaining) on the HOTEL SMART side is also sent back to TL-Lincoln. In other words, inventory is managed in 【販売在庫】 (Sales inventory) in HOTEL SMART, and TL-Lincoln is the side that receives those numbers (from the official manual). The following operations automatically send the changed inventory to TL-Lincoln: creating, changing or canceling a reservation, blocking a room (Scene 9), and changing the adjustment count. It takes up to 15 minutes to take effect (from the official manual). The inventory sent is calculated as "sales inventory = rooms remaining + adjustment count", and rooms remaining as "total rooms − reservations − blocks". If the result is negative, 0 is sent (from the official manual). While two-way integration is active, if you change the rooms remaining by hand on the TL-Lincoln screen, it is overwritten with the HOTEL SMART number at the next update. Increase or decrease inventory in HOTEL SMART (from the official manual). Inventory is not reflected in slots set to 「照会のみ」 (inquiry only) on the TL-Lincoln side (from the official manual). TL-Lincoln's online sales use inventory per 「ネット室タイプグループ」 (online room type group), and sales sites in the same group share the rooms remaining. Inventory cannot be split per sales site (from the official manual). Check the inventory numbers in 【販売在庫】＞【販売在庫カレンダー】 (Sales inventory > Sales inventory calendar) in the left menu. Choose the property and period and press 「在庫数を表示する」 (Show inventory) to see the inventory per sales room type per day. Press an inventory number to see its breakdown (rooms remaining and adjustment count). Days with no inventory created show a ⚠ mark; on those days no inventory is sent to TL-Lincoln and rooms cannot be sold. Days with sales stopped (closed out) are shown in gray (from the official manual; not yet confirmed on Araki Hotel's screen). Only the manager changes inventory numbers Changing the adjustment count (it can also be changed in bulk with 「調整数一括変換」 (Bulk change adjustment count)), closing out (stopping sales), 「指定期間の販売在庫を作成」 (Create sales inventory for a specified period), and stopping the two-way integration itself affect all sales, so the manager (person in charge) does them. If at the front desk you notice a ⚠ mark (a period with no inventory created) or feel that the number of rooms selling on OTAs is wrong, tell the manager. The settings are covered in Initial setup, "Sales inventory" and "TL-Lincoln integration" (from the official manual).

heading: Adding or removing rooms
text: Press 「宿泊変更」 (Change stay) in the 《予約情報》 (Reservation info) section of the reservation details, and in 「人数変更」 (Change number of guests) press 「部屋タイプを追加」 (Add room type). Enter the room type, number of rooms and number of guests per room to add, and press 「保存」 (Save). The added room has no room number assigned, so choose a room in the room assignment of the reservation details or use 「おまかせ割り当て」 (Auto assign). To remove a room, on the same screen press 「×」 on the row to remove and press 「保存」 (Save) (checked 2026-10-05). In 「宿泊変更」 (Change stay) → 「人数変更」 (Change number of guests), 「部屋タイプを追加」 (Add room type) was pressed and a row for BEKKAN ツイン (Twin) (1 room, 1 guest) was added. Reservation details after adding (2 rooms, 2 guests). The added room's number is 「未入力」 (Not entered), and an 「おまかせ割り当て」 (Auto assign) button is shown. This screen was taken after a mid-stay room change was set, so 「途中移動あり」 (Has mid-stay move) is shown. The added row deleted by pressing its 「×」. Reservation details after removing. It is back to 1 room, 1 guest. This screen was taken after a mid-stay room change was set, so 「途中移動あり」 (Has mid-stay move) is shown. Tip For a room with a mid-stay move, the number of rooms, number of guests and deletion could not be changed on the Change stay screen (checked 2026-10-05). Finish changing the number of guests before setting a mid-stay move.

heading: Changing rooms mid-stay
text: To move rooms partway through a multi-night stay, open ［部屋変更］ (Change room) in 「宿泊変更」 (Change stay), click the room on the date the room changes, choose the new room and save. The 「宿泊変更」 (Change stay) → 「部屋変更」 (Change room) screen. The room for each night is listed in date order. In this example, both nights, 10/20 and 10/21, are in 401. The menu opened on the second night's room. Besides the room list, it has 「割当解除」 (Unassign), 「日程削除」 (Delete dates) and 「1泊分操作（途中移動）」 (One-night operation (mid-stay move)). 403 selected for the second night. The first night stays in 401, the second night (10/21) onward becomes 403, and 「途中移動」 (Mid-stay move) is shown on the second night. Reservation details after saving. The room assignment shows 「1部屋（途中移動あり）」 (1 room (has mid-stay move)), with two rows, 401 and 403. Tip When you choose the room for a later night, the confirmation 「1部屋目において◯/◯からの部屋移動を設定します。よろしいですか？」 (Set a room move from ◯/◯ for room 1. Are you sure?) appears, and the rooms from that day on all change together. After a mid-stay move was set, a 「予約を分割」 (Split reservation) button appeared in the reservation details, and the number of rooms in the charges and payment information was counted higher than the actual number of rooms (checked 2026-10-05). However, even though the button appears, a reservation with a mid-stay move cannot be split. According to the official manual, 「更新に失敗しました。」 (Update failed.) appears on saving, the split fails, and you need to contact support (not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel).

heading: Room change (swapping rooms)
text: In the room assignment of the reservation details, press the swap icon next to the room number to open the 「ルームチェンジ」 (Room change) screen. Choose the new room and press 「変更する」 (Change). If you choose a room that has a reservation, the rooms are swapped with that reservation. Pressing 「変更する」 (Change) applied the change immediately, without confirmation (checked 2026-10-06). If there is a past reservation with the same name, 「リピートユーザーの可能性があります。」 (This may be a repeat user.) is shown under the lead guest's name (checked 2026-10-09). The 「ルームチェンジ」 (Room change) screen opened with the swap icon next to the room number. In this example, the current room is 401 (Twin, 10/20 to 10/22, 2 nights), and the vacant room 414 is shown as the recommended new room. The list of new rooms shown by 「他の候補を一覧で表示する」 (Show other candidates in a list). Vacant rooms of the same room type (Twin) are listed (414, 301, 403, 417, 201, 318, 418…). Reservation details after the room change (changed to 403; the room number field is not shown in the image). Because there is a past reservation with the same name, 「リピートユーザーの可能性があります。」 (This may be a repeat user.) is shown under the lead guest's name. You can also do a room change from the room status chart. Click a room in the status chart and press 「ルームチェンジ」 (Room change) in the details; the same 「ルームチェンジ」 (Room change) screen opens as from the reservation details. Pressing 「変更する」 (Change) applies it immediately (checked 2026-10-09). The 「ルームチェンジ」 (Room change) screen opened from the room status chart. The current room is 209 (シングルB, Single B), but CP2 (カプセル, Capsule) is recommended and 「部屋タイプが違います」 (Different room type) is shown. The 「他の候補を一覧で表示する」 (Show other candidates in a list) list. In this example, 「部屋タイプが違います」 (Different room type) is shown for each candidate. Caution If there is no vacancy in the same room type, a different room type is recommended (for example, a capsule for a Single B reservation), and 「部屋タイプが違います」 (Different room type) is shown. Do not just take the recommendation; check the room type before choosing (checked 2026-10-09). From the official online manual Candidate rooms are listed in this order: vacant → same room type → automatic room assignment priority → smallest capacity first. The button is not shown for a reservation without a room assignment. For a reservation with arranged items, the arranged items also move to the new room. When swapping with a room that has a reservation, a screen appears asking whether to move or keep the arranged items (Scene 2, "Arranged items").

heading: Splitting a reservation
text: To split a multi-room reservation into one reservation per room, press 「予約を分割」 (Split reservation) at the top right of the reservation details. Check the lead guest's name and contact details for each resulting reservation, then press 「保存」 (Save). When you save, confirmation messages appear: 「分割後の代表者連絡先が未入力です。予約の分割を継続しますか？」 (The lead guest's contact details after the split are not entered. Continue splitting the reservation?) (when the contact details are empty) and 「この予約は削除され、2件の新しい予約が作成されます。分割を実行しますか？」 (This reservation will be deleted and 2 new reservations will be created. Run the split?). The original reservation is deleted, and new check-in codes are issued. Requests and the operator memo were carried over to all the split reservations, and the repeat memo only to the lead guest's reservation (checked 2026-10-06). The 「予約を分割」 (Split reservation) screen. It shows the proposed reservations split by room (room name, lead guest's name, contact details, stay dates). 「メールを再送信する」 (Resend email) (on by default) with the checkbox cleared. The first reservation after the split. The operator memo records the original check-in code and the check-in codes after the split. The second reservation after the split. Requests and the operator memo are carried over; the repeat memo is not. For a reservation with 3 or more rooms, you can drag and drop rooms on the split screen to keep some rooms together in one reservation (checked 2026-10-09). When you open 「予約を分割」 (Split reservation) for a 3-room reservation (415, 417, 418), 3 proposed rows appear, one per room. Drag a room-name label (e.g., 418) to another row, and that row becomes 2 rooms (417 and 418, 2 guests); the emptied row shows 「（ここにドラッグ＆ドロップしてください）」 (Drag and drop here). After saving, there were 2 reservations: one for 415 and one for 417 and 418. The original reservation is deleted, and new check-in codes are issued. The operator memo keeps 「［ホスト操作：予約分割により作成］」 ([Host operation: created by reservation split]) along with the original and new check-in codes (checked 2026-10-09). The 「予約を分割」 (Split reservation) screen for a 3-room reservation (415, 417, 418). 3 proposed rows appear, one per room. After dragging the 418 label to row 2. Row 2 becomes 417 and 418 (2 guests), and the emptied row 3 shows 「（ここにドラッグ＆ドロップしてください）」 (Drag and drop here). The reservation for 417 and 418 after the split. It has 2 assigned rooms, and the operator memo keeps 「［ホスト操作：予約分割により作成］」 ([Host operation: created by reservation split]) with the original and new check-in codes. Caution If you save with the lead guest's name empty on a combined row, the reservation list shows 「（名前未入力）」 (Name not entered). Before saving, enter the lead guest's name on each row. 「メールを再送信する」 (Resend email) is on each row, so if you do not want to send emails, clear all of them (checked 2026-10-09). Main reservations that cannot be split (from the official manual) The following reservations cannot be split (not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). Separate the guests, charges and payments by room before you split. The reservation details have unsaved changes (save first) Cancelled, or all rooms are already checked in (it can be split if only some rooms are checked in) The check-in date has already gone through daily closing There is a guest not assigned to a room / a charge with no room specified / a payment spanning several rooms The guest moves rooms partway through the stay (mid-stay move) The site controller auto-update is still 「自動更新中」 (Auto-updating) Splitting OTA reservations is the manager's decision For reservations received through the site controller, you must stop the auto-update before splitting. Splitting breaks the link with the site controller, and it cannot be restored later. Changes and cancellations on the OTA side will no longer come in, so the manager decides whether to split (from the official manual). Tip After saving, the first reservation opens in the same tab and the second and later ones open in new tabs. If the browser's pop-up blocker is on, the new tabs may not open; in that case, open them from the list in 【予約情報】 (Reservation information). Also, you cannot save if even one room is left in 〖未設定の部屋一覧〗 (Unassigned room list), so put every room into one of the rows (from the official manual). Reading the split screen (from the official manual) To separate combined rooms again, create an empty row with 「予約を追加する」 (Add reservation) and drop the room into it; remove rows you do not need with 「予約を削除する」 (Delete reservation). Room block colors: orange = before check-in, yellow-green = staying, blue-green = checked out (before cleaning). A slot with no room decided shows 「未定」 (Undecided), and a room with children shows a child icon. A row with no guests cannot become a reservation (not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). What is and is not carried over after a split (from the official manual) For rows with 「メールを再送信する」 (Resend email) checked, the sending records for the reservation confirmation, check-in guide and reminder are reset, and these emails are queued to be sent again to the new lead guest. Whether and when they are sent follows the property's email settings. In addition to requests and the operator memo, cleaning notes and meal notes are also carried over. The reservation's additional information goes to the first reservation in the list. Color labels attached to memos and receipt requests received through the guest My Page are not carried over. Re-add them after the split if needed. If all the rooms in a split reservation are checked in, that reservation is created as checked in. A split cannot be undone. There is no function to restore the original single reservation, so check the contents carefully before saving. (At Araki Hotel, only the carry-over of requests, the operator memo and the repeat memo has been confirmed. See "checked 2026-10-06" above.)

heading: Merging and grouping reservations
text: In the list in 【予約情報】 (Reservation information), check the reservations you want to combine and press 「チェックした予約の統合またはグルーピング」 (Merge or group checked reservations). The buttons 「これらの予約を統合する」 (Merge these reservations) and 「これらの予約をグルーピングする」 (Group these reservations) appear. 「統合」 (Merge) joins reservations with consecutive dates (one reservation's check-out date is another reservation's check-in date). If the conditions are not met, 「これらの予約は統合できません」 (These reservations cannot be merged) appears. 「グルーピング」 (Grouping) combines reservations with the same dates into one (checked 2026-10-06). 2 reservations checked in the list in 【予約情報】 (Reservation information). Pressing 「チェックした予約の統合またはグルーピング」 (Merge or group checked reservations) shows the list of selected reservations and 「これらの予約を統合する」 (Merge these reservations) and 「これらの予約をグルーピングする」 (Group these reservations). After grouping. Combined into 1 reservation (2 rooms, 2 guests). Reservation details after grouping. The shared notes from the original 2 reservations are shown joined together, and the grouping is recorded in the operator memo. Caution When you run grouping, the confirmation 「一度グルーピングした予約は元に戻せません」 (Once grouped, reservations cannot be restored) appears. The combined reservation collects the guest information, rooms, charges and payments of the original reservations; only the base reservation's status and similar settings remain (checked 2026-10-06). From the official online manual The condition for grouping is "same check-in date"; the check-out dates may differ. Neither merging nor grouping is possible in the following cases. Different property, booking channel or corporate/group account Includes a provisional reservation, or includes charges or payments already through daily closing (Grouping) Includes a checked-in reservation (Merging) The number of guests or rooms differs between reservations After combining, charges are not recalculated automatically, and the rate plans of the original reservations remain. Check the charge details after combining. After grouping, the check-in code is the one of the reservation shown at the top of the confirmation screen. When merging, confirmation appears twice before it runs, and a record is left in the operator memo when it finishes. The merged dates run from the earliest check-in date to the latest check-out date. The check-in code and room information of the reservation with the earlier check-in date are kept. For reservations prepaid via an OTA, the start date for accounts receivable changes to the merged check-out date. Not only grouping but merging also cannot be undone. When reservations cannot be combined or need to be separated (from the official manual) Reservations with different booking channels (booking sites) cannot be merged or grouped, because one reservation cannot have more than one booking channel. Keep them as separate reservations and handle them by, for example, assigning the same room or manually setting the later reservation as checked in. Combined reservations can be separated with Splitting a reservation, but they do not return completely to their original state. If site controller reservations are being grouped automatically and this causes problems, it can be changed in the integration settings (disconnect the integration once, and when reconnecting choose 「別々の予約として登録する」 (Register as separate reservations)). This affects the whole integration, so the manager consults support. Merging OTA reservations is the manager's decision A merged reservation no longer receives auto-updates from the site controller. Changes or cancellations on the OTA side will not come in, so the manager decides whether to merge (grouping, in principle, keeps auto-updating). Merging also changes the guest My Page URL, and the old URL stops working. Send the new URL to the guest again if needed (from the official manual; not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel).

heading: Checking and changing guest information
text: Click 「宿泊者台帳」 (Guest register) in 《宿泊者情報》 (Guest information) to check and edit guest information in a list, assign rooms, and add or remove guests. The 「宿泊者台帳」 (Guest register) screen. Switch between nights to view it, and check or enter name, phonetic name (furigana), gender, category, phone, email, nationality and so on. The list in 〖宿泊者情報〗 (Guest information). Names are links; pressing one opens that guest's detail page (screen example from the official manual, showing a demo property). (Source: HOTEL SMART official online manual) From the 「引用」 (Copy from past guest) icon in the guest register, you can copy the information of a guest who stayed before. When you press 「引用する」 (Copy), 「以下の宿泊者情報を設定しますか？」 (Set the following guest information?) appears with the information to be copied. After copying, press 「保存」 (Save) in the register (checked 2026-10-06). According to the official manual, copying fills in name, phonetic name (furigana), email address, phone number, postal code, prefecture, address, nationality, gender and child category. If you also enter a company name in the search, only guests matching both the name (or other fields) and the company name appear. 「詳細を開く」 (Open details) in the search results lets you check the source reservation in a new tab (from the official manual; not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). Guest register for a multi-room reservation. The guest for the second room is blank. 「過去宿泊者情報の引用」 (Copy past guest information), opened from the 「引用」 (Copy from past guest) icon. Search by name / furigana / phone number / E-Mail and company name. Search results. Property, booking date, stay dates, name and so on are shown. 「引用する」 (Copy) puts the guest into the register. The register after copying. A guest has been entered for the second room. Finally, press 「保存」 (Save) in the register.

heading: Checking repeat-guest detection and judging it manually
text: HOTEL SMART automatically detects whether a reservation belongs to a repeat guest (a guest who has stayed before). When detected, the lead guest's guest information and repeat memo are carried over to the next reservation. The following is the official manual's explanation (at Araki Hotel, only the 「リピートユーザーの可能性があります。」 (Possible repeat user.) display has been confirmed; see the image in Room change). How repeat-guest detection works (from the official manual) Fields used for detection The lead guest's name, email address and phone number. Spaces between family and given names and hyphens in phone numbers do not matter Automatically marked as repeat Same name, and also the same email address or phone number. A repeat mark appears under the lead guest's name Repeat not judged (possible repeat) Only one of name, email address or phone number matches. 「リピートユーザーの可能性があります」 (Possible repeat user) appears under the lead guest's name When detection runs When a reservation is imported from the site controller, and when a reservation is created manually What is carried over The lead guest's name, address, email address, phone number, nationality, date of birth, occupation, passport image, face photo and ID. The information with the newer update date is kept. Companions are not checked (for companions, use Copy past guest information) Press the 「リピートユーザーの可能性があります」 (Possible repeat user) display (under the lead guest's name in the reservation list or reservation details) to open the judgment screen. You can also check and judge unjudged reservations by pressing the count for 「リピート未判定予約数」 (Reservations with repeat not judged) on the dashboard. If you can confirm it is the same guest, press 「この代表者の予約履歴と情報を統合する」 (Merge information with this lead guest's reservation history) on the matching reservation history. If it is a different person, press 「どの予約履歴とも情報を統合しない」 (Do not merge information with any reservation history). Do not link to a different person (from the official manual) A repeat judgment cannot be undone. If you link a different person with the same name, someone else's address and ID information will be carried over. If you cannot confirm it is the same person by phone number, address and so on, choose 「統合しない」 (Do not merge). Also, if you update the reservation after the judgment, the My Page email may be sent to a guest who has not received it yet.

heading: Changing the rate plan
text: Select the new rate plan in [プラン] (Plan), then press the 「プランに合わせる」 (Match plan) button in [お食事] (Meals) and save. After saving, you can change the charges to match the new rate plan from 「料金情報の再登録」 (Re-register charge information) in the 《料金詳細》 (Charge details) section. The 「プランに合わせる」 (Match plan) button in ［お食事］ (Meals) is a step that does not appear in the official manual, and it has not been confirmed on Araki Hotel's real screen either. The 「料金情報の再登録」 (Re-register charge information) button at the bottom right of 《料金詳細》 (Charge details), shown in a red frame (screen example from the official manual, showing a demo property). (Source: HOTEL SMART official online manual) To change the rate plan only for some days or some guests, use 「宿泊変更」 (Change stay) → 「個別プラン変更」 (Individual plan change). Even in this case, the first day's rate plan is used for screen displays and totals. Meal details can be changed per day and per guest from 「食事変更」 (Change meals) in 〖予約情報〗 (Reservation information) (from the official manual; not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). 「宿泊変更」 (Change stay) → 「個別プラン変更」 (Individual plan change). Press a cell for a day and room and choose a plan. The drop-down also has 「個別設定解除」 (Clear individual setting) and 「プランなしにする」 (Set to no plan) (screen example from the official manual, showing a demo property). (Source: HOTEL SMART official online manual) The 「食事変更」 (Change meals) button in the 「お食事」 (Meals) row of 〖予約情報〗 (Reservation information), shown in a red frame (screen example from the official manual, showing a demo property). (Source: HOTEL SMART official online manual)

heading: Stopping the site controller auto-update
text: According to the official manual, pressing 「停止する」 (Stop) at ［サイトコントローラー自動更新］ (Site controller auto-update) (status shown as 「自動更新中」 (Auto-updating)) in the 〖共有事項〗 (Shared notes) section of the reservation details lets you change even site controller reservations from the admin screen (official articles from 2025 onward also show it this way). An earlier version of this manual said "in ［サイトコントローラー設定］ (Site controller settings) under 《設定》 (Settings) on the right, 『この予約の自動更新を停止する』 (Stop auto-update for this reservation)", but that may be the wording of an older screen. The location and button name on Araki Hotel's real screen are not yet confirmed. When you stop it, a record of the stop is automatically left in the operator memo, so you can check later who stopped it and when (from the official manual). ［サイトコントローラー自動更新］ (Site controller auto-update) in 〖共有事項〗 (Shared notes). There is a 「停止する」 (Stop) button next to 「自動更新中」 (Auto-updating) (screen example from the official manual, showing a demo property). (Source: HOTEL SMART official online manual) Caution After stopping, changes to the reservation details or status on the OTA or site controller are not reflected. Once stopped, as a rule do not restart it. If you restart it, the changes you made may be reverted by the update. When OTA changes are not reflected (from the official manual) Changes sent from the OTA while auto-update is stopped are not reflected even if you restart auto-update later. The stop is recorded in the operator memo, so first check whether it is stopped. Also, for checked-in reservations or reservations already through daily closing, some changes are not reflected depending on their content. If none of these apply and changes are still not reflected, the manager contacts support.

heading: Cancelling a reservation
text: Front desk staff can cancel reservations at their own discretion. Press the status at the top right of the reservation details (「未チェックイン ▼」 (Not checked in ▼)) and choose 「キャンセルする」 (Cancel). Step 1: The status menu. It has 「チェックイン済みにする」 (Set as checked in), 「キャンセルする」 (Cancel) and 「削除する」 (Delete). Check the details on the confirmation screen and press 「キャンセルする」 (Cancel). Step 2: The confirmation screen 「この予約をキャンセルしてよろしいですか？」 (Are you sure you want to cancel this reservation?). It states that room assignments will be removed and unsaved changes will be discarded. Reservation details after cancellation. The status becomes 「キャンセル済み」 (Cancelled), the room number shows 「未入力」 (Not entered), and the operation history (host operation: cancel) is recorded in the operator memo. After cancelling, always report the reservation name, dates and reason for cancellation to the manager. Caution The menu also has 「削除する」 (Delete), but it erases the reservation data itself. 「削除する」 (Delete) is only for cleaning up test reservations; do not use it on real reservations. For normal cancellations, use 「キャンセルする」 (Cancel) and keep the reservation in the history. In the official manual, test reservations are deleted after changing the lead guest's name to "test" in the guest register and saving. Checked-in reservations (undo the check-in first) and reservations whose stay period has gone through daily closing cannot be deleted (from the official manual). Unlike cancellation, the confirmation screen for 「削除する」 (Delete) shows no warning. For a reservation with no room assigned, 「チェックイン済みにする」 (Set as checked in) did not appear in the status menu (checked 2026-10-06). The confirmation screen when you choose 「削除する」 (Delete): 「この予約情報を削除しますか？」 (Delete this reservation information?). No warning is shown. Caution When cancelling a reservation that has already been paid, how to handle the refund is the manager's decision. Check with the manager before cancelling. From the official online manual A reservation left as a no-show (guest did not arrive) is counted in sales and occupancy. Once you know the guest will not come, cancel it before daily closing (after closing, the cancellation status cannot be changed). Charges and payments registered on a cancelled reservation are not counted in sales. To record a cancellation fee, register it in 予約外_料金・精算 (charges and payments not linked to a reservation) (Scene 6 "Sales not linked to a reservation"). Reservations cancelled on the OTA side are cancelled automatically. There is also an optional feature (separate contract) for charging cancellation fees online, so check with the manager whether it is used. Before cancelling (from the official manual) For a reservation with planned use of facilities, cancelling erases the facility information, and it does not come back even if you undo the cancellation (Scene 2 "Facilities"). Arranged items stay on the reservation but no longer appear in 【手配品一覧】 (Arranged items list). When you cancel a reservation in HOTEL SMART, the freed room inventory is sent to TL-Lincoln automatically via two-way integration (TL-Lincoln (two-way) and inventory).

heading: 5. Registering charges (sales)
text: Bottom of the reservation details page < 料金・精算情報 (Charges and payment information) > 料金詳細 (Charge details) Charge details can be switched between 「部屋別料金」 (Charges by room) and 「日別料金」 (Charges by day). They are shown in expandable rows per room / per day, and you can register charges at each level. Press 「料金追加」 (Add charge) in the 《料金・精算情報》 (Charges and payment information) section. In the 《新規料金情報》 (New charge information) that appears, enter the charge item, date of use, room, unit price, quantity, payment (shown only if payment integration is set up) and notes, then save. Step 1: Pressing 「料金追加」 (Add charge) opens the 《新規料金情報》 (New charge information) input screen. Step 2: The charge item, date of use, room, unit price and so on entered. The subtotal is calculated automatically. After entering, press 「保存する」 (Save). 《料金詳細》 (Charge details) after registration. Before payment, the outstanding balance is shown in red in the 《料金・精算情報》 (Charges and payment information) section. Step 2: 《新規料金情報》 (New charge information) right after choosing the charge item (宿泊費 (Accommodation fee)). The unit price from the charge item master (0 yen) was filled in automatically, so the unit price entered earlier became 0. The 「保存する」 (Save) button is not shown yet. The charge item and unit price entered. Once the required fields are filled, the 「保存する」 (Save) button appears. Tip When you choose a charge item, the unit price and consumption tax registered in the charge item master are filled in automatically. At this property, the master unit price for 「宿泊費」 (Accommodation fee) is 0 yen, so the unit price entered earlier became 0 (checked 2026-10-06). Choose the charge item first, then enter the unit price. The 「保存する」 (Save) button appears once the required fields are filled. Input fields for registering a charge 料金科目 (Charge item) Sales breakdown category, such as accommodation fee or meal charge 利用日／部屋 (Date of use / Room) The same content can be registered from either the Charges by room or the Charges by day view 単価・数量 (Unit price / Quantity) Breakdown of the amount. The subtotal is calculated automatically 決済 (Payment) Shown and selectable only if payment integration is set up Red highlighting in the charge details marks a missing or duplicate accommodation fee. According to the official manual, for charges whose main category is 「宿泊費」 (Accommodation fee), the row turns red if any of these applies: there is no accommodation fee on a stay date, there are 2 or more accommodation fees for the same room on the same day, or there is an accommodation fee with no date or room specified. Site controller reservations are excluded, and accounts without main categories set up do not turn red (from the official manual). In front-08 above, the room row stays red even after registering 10,000 yen; this may be because the charge was treated as something other than an accommodation fee, but the reason is not confirmed. Caution Charges that have already been paid cannot be changed or deleted. To fix a charge, first delete the payment from 「詳細」 (Details) in 《支払い情報》 (Payment information), then change or delete the charge (from the official online manual). Where to start when deleting a payment. Press 「詳細」 (Details) (red frame) on the right of the row in 〖支払情報〗 (Payment information) (screen example from the official manual, showing a demo property). (Source: HOTEL SMART official online manual) The payment information screen opened from 「詳細」 (Details). To fix the breakdown, payment method, payment date and so on, press 「保存する」 (Save); to delete the payment, press 「削除する」 (Delete) at the bottom right (screen example from the official manual, showing a demo property). (Source: HOTEL SMART official online manual) Where to start when fixing a charge. Expand 《料金詳細》 (Charge details) and press the item name of the charge you want to fix (e.g., 宿泊費 (Accommodation fee), red frame). Each day's row also has 「料金追加」 (Add charge) (screen example from the official manual, showing a demo property). (Source: HOTEL SMART official online manual) The charge information screen that opens when you press the item name. Fix the content and press 「保存する」 (Save); to delete the charge, press 「削除する」 (Delete) at the bottom right (screen example from the official manual, showing a demo property). (Source: HOTEL SMART official online manual) How to fix charges (from the official online manual) To fix a charge, click the item name of the charge in 〖料金詳細〗 (Charge details), fix the content in the screen that opens and press 「保存する」 (Save); to delete it, press 「削除する」 (Delete). To delete a payment, open it from 「詳細」 (Details) in 〖支払情報〗 (Payment information). Accommodation fees created from rate plan prices can also be fixed in 「宿泊変更」 (Change stay) → 「金額変更」 (Change amount), but charges from the site controller and charges registered from the charge details do not appear in 「金額変更」 (Change amount). Charges and payments on days that have gone through daily closing cannot be changed, so make adjustments with 予約外_料金・精算 (charges and payments not linked to a reservation) (Scene 6). Not yet confirmed on Araki Hotel's real screen.

heading: 6. Registering payments
text: Bottom of the reservation details page ＜ 料金・精算情報 (Charges and payment information) ＞ 支払情報 (Payment information) ＋ 売上管理 (Sales management) ＞ 予約外_料金・精算機能 (Non-reservation charges and payments) (sales not linked to a reservation) You can settle payments in three ways: 「一括精算」 (Bulk payment), 「料金選択して精算」 (Pay selected charges) and 「金額指定して精算（特殊精算）」 (Pay a specified amount (special payment)). This scene also covers registering and settling sales that are not linked to a reservation (予約外_料金・精算機能 (Non-reservation charges and payments)).

heading: Bulk payment / paying selected charges
text: To settle the whole outstanding balance, click 「一括精算」 (Bulk payment). To settle specific charges, select those charges and click 「選択精算」 (Pay selected). Select the payment method and type, enter whether points are used and the payment date, then click 「精算する」 (Settle). You can also reselect the charges to settle here. Step 2: The bulk payment input screen. Specify the payment method (事前決済 (prepaid) / 現地決済 (pay at the hotel)), type, points and payment date, then press 「精算する」 (Settle). After payment. The date, amount, type and payment method are registered in 《支払い情報》 (Payment information), and the outstanding balance display disappears. The payment method types are 「現金／決済代行サービス／クレジットカード／電子マネー／ID決済／行政補助金／その他」 (Cash / Payment agency service / Credit card / E-money / ID payment / Government subsidy / Other). The payment date defaults to today. When we saved with a date outside the stay period, a confirmation appeared: 「支払日が宿泊期間外に指定されています。保存を続行してよろしいですか？」 (The payment date is outside the stay period. Continue saving?) (checked 2026-10-06). From the official online manual The payment methods shown on the payment screen are decided by each property's settings (the 「表示する／表示しない」 (Show / Hide) setting in 物件管理＞物件情報＞支払い方法設定 (Property management > Property information > Payment method settings)). If a payment method you need is not shown, ask the administrator to set it to show. For a corporate or group reservation with an advance payment set up, choose 「前受金の取り崩し」 (Use advance payment) as the payment method on the payment screen and specify the drawdown date (it is reflected in the advance payment report and so on only after the daily closing and totals for the drawdown date are done). This is needed only when using a corporate advance payment (for details see "Corporate and group advance payments and accounts receivable (later payment)" below). When using two kinds of coupons (from the official manual) You can combine them by choosing 「地域クーポン」 (Regional coupon) under the 「行政補助金」 (Government subsidy) payment type for the first one, and for the second one attaching a corporation or group to the reservation as the receivable account and settling with that receivable. If the reservation is already a corporate or group reservation with a receivable account, or if three or more kinds are used, this method cannot register them all, so use the 「その他」 (Other) payment method (not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). In 《料金詳細》 (Charge details), the room (line items) to settle is checked. The payment screen opened with 「選択精算」 (Pay selected). Only the checked items make up the payment amount. The payment date changed to the check-in date (11/20). After payment. One row is added to 《支払い情報》 (Payment information), and the checkboxes of paid line items turn gray and can no longer be selected. To correct a charge that has already been paid, you must first delete the payment (see the caution in Scene 5).

heading: Paying a specified amount
text: Click 「特殊精算（金額指定）」 (Special payment (specify amount)). Enter the breakdown (料金科目指定 (By charge item) / 金額指定 (By amount) / 部屋指定 (By room)), payment method (事前決済 (prepaid) / 現地決済 (pay at the hotel)), payment date and amount, then click 「保存する」 (Save). The 「未収金の支払い」 (Outstanding balance payment) screen opened with 「特殊精算（金額指定）」 (Special payment (specify amount)). Choose the breakdown from 「料金科目指定／金額指定／部屋指定」 (By charge item / By amount / By room). If the payment date is outside the stay period, 「宿泊期間外です」 (Outside the stay period) is shown. ¥3,000 entered by amount, with the payment date set to 11/20. After payment. The total paid and outstanding balance are updated, and a second row is added to 《支払い情報》 (Payment information). A 「未登録」 (Unregistered) row has appeared at the bottom of the charge details. The 「未登録」 (Unregistered) row opened. It contains two 「一部支払い済み」 (Partially paid) line items, −¥3,000 and +¥3,000. Caution When you pay by a specified amount, an 「未登録」 (Unregistered) row not linked to any room is created at the bottom of the charge details, containing two adjustment line items called 「一部支払い済み」 (Partially paid) (checked 2026-10-06). These are not charges registered by mistake, so do not delete them. Tip When the outstanding balance spans several rooms, you can narrow the payment range by checking the target rooms and dates individually.

heading: Sales not linked to a reservation (予約外_料金・精算機能 (Non-reservation charges and payments))
text: Use this for sales not linked to a reservation, such as cancellation fees and shop sales, and for amount adjustments after the daily closing (from the official manual). A statement or receipt cannot be issued from a non-reservation bill (from the official manual). Open 「売上管理」 (Sales management) → 「予約外_料金・精算機能」 (Non-reservation charges and payments) in the left menu and press 「新規作成」 (Create new). Select the property, booking channel and corporation/group, then press 「次へ」 (Next). Register the charge with 「料金情報を追加する」 (Add charge information). Register the payment with 「精算をする」 (Settle), then return to the list with 「閉じる」 (Close). Step 1: The list in 【売上管理】＞【予約外_料金・精算機能】 (Sales management > Non-reservation charges and payments) (before registering). Register from 「新規作成」 (Create new). The selection screen opened with 「新規作成」 (Create new) (property, booking channel, corporation/group). The property defaults to 「種子島あらきホテル」 (Tanegashima Araki Hotel). Step 2: The property set to 「種子島あらき別館」 (Tanegashima Araki Annex) and the booking channel set to 「その他」 (Other). The bill screen after 「次へ」 (Next). There are no charges yet. Step 3: 《新規料金情報》 (New charge information) opened with 「料金情報を追加する」 (Add charge information). A unit price of ¥500 and a note entered. The bill after registering the charge. The outstanding balance is shown as ¥500. Step 4: The 「未収金の支払い」 (Outstanding balance payment) screen opened with 「精算をする」 (Settle). Choose the breakdown from 「料金科目指定／金額指定」 (By charge item / By amount). The bill after payment. A payment row is added. Return to the list with 「閉じる」 (Close). Back on the list. The control number, total charges, payment method, total received and outstanding balance are shown. Caution When creating new, the property defaulted to 「種子島あらきホテル」 (Tanegashima Araki Hotel). Switch the property before registering sales for the annex. An empty bill is created as soon as you press 「次へ」 (Next). Currently the only charge item registered is 「宿泊費」 (Accommodation charge); to use this for shop sales and the like, charge items need to be added (checked 2026-10-06). From the official online manual The booking channel and corporation/group you choose when creating new specify the receivable account for that bill. If you attach a corporation or group, you can also use advance payment drawdown and later payment ("Corporate and group advance payments and accounts receivable" below). Sales are recorded on the use date. Accounts receivable are recorded on the payment date, regardless of the corporation's or group's start-timing setting. If the use date or payment date is blank, it is recorded on the date of entry. The list can be filtered by period and property. The non-reservation list cannot be exported to CSV. In the payment information CSV, reservation and non-reservation amounts are combined (on the daily closing screen they are separate rows).

heading: Entering refunds
text: Entering refunds Enter refunds from 【売上管理】→【予約外_料金・精算機能】 (Sales management → Non-reservation charges and payments) → 「詳細を開く」 (Open details) on the bill → 「返金入力」 (Enter refund) at the bottom. The 「返金入力」 (Enter refund) screen has these fields: breakdown (amount), payment method (two choices such as cash under 「返金」 (Refund)), payment date, note and payment amount; register with 「保存する」 (Save). We could not find an 「返金入力」 (Enter refund) button in 《料金・精算情報》 (Charges and payment information) on the reservation details. This time we only opened the screen to check it and did not save. How the bill looks after a refund is not yet confirmed (checked 2026-10-09). The details of a non-reservation bill. At the bottom are the 「閉じる」 (Close) and 「返金入力」 (Enter refund) buttons. The 「返金入力」 (Enter refund) screen. Enter the breakdown (amount), payment method (such as cash under 「返金」 (Refund)), payment date, note and payment amount, and register with 「保存する」 (Save). Example of a bill after saving a refund entry. Two rows are added: a negative charge with the charge item 「返金」 (Refund) (type: 調整金 (Adjustment)), and a negative payment of type 「返金」 (Refund) (e.g. cash) (sample screen from the official manual; this is a demo property's screen). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル (official online manual, in Japanese)) From the official online manual With 「返金入力」 (Enter refund) on a bill, you can reverse a charge and a payment in one operation. In the official procedure, instead of opening an existing bill, you create a new bill with 「新規作成」 (Create new) by choosing the property, booking channel and corporation/group, and press 「返金入力」 (Enter refund) there (registering the refund as a separate bill). The manager (person in charge) should decide which way to operate. How the bill looks after a refund is still not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel. The charge item cannot be specified, so if you want to specify a charge item, register a negative charge with that item. This is also used to correct amounts after the daily closing.

heading: Checking in-house outstanding balances at once (滞在中精算チェックリスト (In-house payment checklist))
text: Open 【売上管理】→【滞在中精算チェックリスト】 (Sales management → In-house payment checklist) and select a property and date; the reservations in house on that day (including reservations whose check-out date is that day) are shown one per row (checked 2026-10-10). The columns are check-in code, lead guest name, room number, check-in, check-out, total charges, total paid, total advance payment drawn down, outstanding balance, corporation/group name and advance payment balance. Outstanding balances are shown in red. Click a check-in code to go to the reservation details. With 「csvダウンロード」 (CSV download) at the top right, you can save the same content as a CSV (checked 2026-10-10). 【売上管理】→【滞在中精算チェックリスト】 (Sales management → In-house payment checklist) (Tanegashima Araki Hotel, 2026-10-10). In-house reservations are listed one per row; in this example an outstanding balance of ¥6,650 is shown in red. 「csvダウンロード」 (CSV download) is at the top right. Tip The daily closing screen also warns about outstanding balances, but only at closing time. On this screen you can check all rooms with outstanding balances at any time during the day. To avoid missing anything before check-out, we recommend checking it in the morning and evening.

heading: Corporate and group advance payments and accounts receivable (later payment)
text: This covers payment when a corporate or group customer pays money in advance (advance payment) and when they are billed later in one lump (accounts receivable). The reservation must have a corporation or group attached (Scene 3 "Register a corporation or group and attach it to a reservation"). The following is the official manual's explanation (not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). How to settle corporate and group payments (from the official manual) Using an advance payment (reservation) On the payment screen, check 「前受金の取り崩し」 (Use advance payment) under ［支払い方法］ (Payment method), select the drawdown date and press 「精算する」 (Settle). To draw down per use date, check 「利用日を取崩日として分割登録」 (Register separately with the use date as the drawdown date) Using an advance payment (non-reservation) Attach the corporation or group in 「新規作成」 (Create new) of the non-reservation charges and payments, then on the outstanding balance payment screen set ［支払い方法］ (Payment method) to 「前受金の取り崩し」 (Use advance payment) and save Putting on accounts receivable (reservation) For a reservation with a receivable corporation or group attached, choose 「後日決済」 (Pay later) when settling. For accounts whose start timing is check-in/check-out, select the registration date; for accounts whose start timing is the posting date, select the posting date; then press 「精算する」 (Settle). To post per use date, check 「利用日を計上日として分割登録」 (Register separately with the use date as the posting date) Putting on accounts receivable (non-reservation) Attach the corporation or group in 「新規作成」 (Create new), then on the outstanding balance payment screen set ［支払い方法］ (Payment method) to 「後日精算」 (Pay later) and save Register receipt of an advance payment (deposit) from 「前受金情報作成」 (Create advance payment information) in 〖前受金管理〗 (Advance payment management) on the corporation's or group's details screen. Check advance payment deposits and drawdowns in 【売上管理】＞【前受金報告書】 (Sales management > Advance payment report) (it can also be opened from the corporation's or group's details) by selecting the corporation/group, property and period. Drawn-down amounts appear in the report and balance only after the daily closing and totals for the drawdown date are done. Corporations and groups with an insufficient advance payment balance are shown on the daily closing screen. Advance payment deposits can also be checked in the income and expenditure report (from the official manual). Accounts receivable are totaled in 【売上管理】＞【売掛・入金報告書】 (Sales management > Accounts receivable and deposit report). When a later deposit arrives, enter the deposit information with 「新規作成」 (Create new) in 【売上管理】＞【入金情報管理】 (Sales management > Deposit information management) and press 「変更を保存する」 (Save changes); you can then check the balance in the accounts receivable and deposit report. Check a registered deposit with 「詳細を見る」 (View details) in the list (from the official manual). Caution when registering deposits (from the official manual) In 「売掛金の消込金額」 (Receivable amount cleared), enter the amount of receivables the deposit covers, not the amount actually received in the account (after fees). Once deposit information is registered, it can be neither deleted nor changed. Registering advance payments and deposits should be done by the manager (or the accounting staff) after checking the amounts. The setting for using advance payments (［前受金設定］ (Advance payment setting) of the corporation or group) is covered in the initial setup guide.

heading: 7. Issuing statements and receipts
text: Reservation details page ＞ 利用明細・領収書 (Statement and receipt) Issue them from the 《利用明細・領収書》 (Statement and receipt) section. What is registered in 《料金詳細》 (Charge details) at the time of creation is reflected on the screen. Prepaid reservations (paid on the OTA) The hotel issues receipts only for what it received at the hotel. For amounts prepaid on the booking site, direct the guest to the booking site's receipt (from the official manual). Be careful not to issue a duplicate. To create one covering only what was received at the hotel, use 「領収項目に絞る」 (Limit to receipt items) below. Revenue stamp If you receive 50,000 yen or more (excluding tax) in cash and hand over a paper receipt, a revenue stamp is required. It is not required if you hand it over electronically, such as by email (from the official manual).

heading: Creating
text: Select the target room (for a multi-room reservation, check only the relevant room). To issue with the charges split by rate plan combined into the accommodation charge, check 「プラン仕訳料金を統合する」 (Combine plan-split charges). Then press 「明細・領収書作成」 (Create statement/receipt). Step 1: The 《利用明細・領収書》 (Statement and receipt) section of the reservation details. Select the target room and press 「明細・領収書作成」 (Create statement/receipt). On the 《利用明細・領収書作成》 (Create statement/receipt) screen, check the language setting (Japanese / English / Chinese / Korean), tax category, addressee, honorific, arrival date, departure date, remarks, line items, room number, use date, amount, receipt amount and description (purpose), then press 「発行する」 (Issue). If anything needs changing, correct it here. Step 2: The 《利用明細・領収書作成》 (Create statement/receipt) screen. Check the language setting, tax category, addressee, arrival/departure dates, line items, receipt amount and description. The description entered (example: 「ご宿泊代」 (accommodation charge)). After checking the content, press 「発行する」 (Issue). Tip For a reservation that checked out before its check-out date, the 「ご出発日」 (Departure date) on the creation screen showed the date the guest actually checked out (checked 2026-10-05). Check the addressee, dates and description before issuing, and correct them as needed. From the official online manual The description can be entered only when there is a receipt amount. If you create the document before registering the payment, you cannot enter a description and it becomes a statement only, so register the payment first and then create it. There is no setting to make a fixed description the default; enter it each time. The addressee can be chosen from the lead guest name, the corporation/group name, the addressee entered in a receipt request, or any addressee. The default of 「プラン仕訳料金を統合する」 (Combine plan-split charges) is decided by 〖明細書設定〗 (Statement settings) in the property details (the honorific and addressee choices on the creation screen opened from the reservation details are not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). Receipts can also be issued from the room status chart (checked 2026-10-09). Click a room in the status chart and press 「領収書発行」 (Issue receipt) in ［料金情報］ (Charge information) in the details; the 「領収書発行」 (Issue receipt) screen opens. The screen's fields are language (Japanese / English / Chinese / Korean), addressee, honorific (様), arrival date, departure date, remarks, items (charge items and payment items), amount used, amount deposited, amount billed and receipt amount. Issue with 「発行する」 (Issue). The details opened by clicking a room in the room status chart. There are 「ルームチェンジ」 (Room change), 「領収書発行」 (Issue receipt), 「チェックイン」 (Check-in) and 「予約詳細」 (Reservation details) buttons. The 「領収書発行」 (Issue receipt) screen (upper half). Check the language, addressee, honorific (様), arrival date, departure date and remarks. The 「領収書発行」 (Issue receipt) screen (lower half). Check the items (charge items and payment items) and the amount used, amount deposited, amount billed and receipt amount, then press 「発行する」 (Issue). Caution The 「領収書発行」 (Issue receipt) screen in the status chart has no 「但し書き」 (Description) field. When a description is needed, create the receipt from 《利用明細・領収書》 (Statement and receipt) in the reservation details (that screen has a 「但し［ ］として」 (For [ ]) field) (checked 2026-10-09). Receipts issued from the status chart were also kept in the history (statement number, created date and time, download) of 《利用明細・領収書》 (Statement and receipt) in the reservation details. 「領収項目に絞る」 (Limit to receipt items) was not on the status chart screen but a checkbox in the 《利用明細・領収書》 (Statement and receipt) section of the reservation details (below 「プラン仕訳料金を統合する」 (Combine plan-split charges)). What happens when it is checked is not yet confirmed (checked 2026-10-09). The 《利用明細・領収書》 (Statement and receipt) section of the reservation details. 「領収項目に絞る」 (Limit to receipt items) is below 「プラン仕訳料金を統合する」 (Combine plan-split charges), and the history lists two entries, including the one issued from the status chart. From the official online manual If you check 「領収項目に絞る」 (Limit to receipt items), the document is created only with items linked to payments that are subject to a receipt, such as payments at the hotel.

heading: Checking and issuing
text: Created documents are listed in 《履歴》 (History), and you can check the PDF from 「ダウンロード」 (Download). Download it and send it by email or print it to hand to the guest. At this property, the downloaded PDF is given by email or in print. The official manual also says there are functions for downloading from the guest My Page (enabled in the property's 【お客様マイページ設定】 (Guest My Page settings)) and for attaching the PDF to the check-in completion email (【自動メール配信設定】 (Automatic email settings)). How these are set at Araki Hotel is not yet confirmed; if they are used, the administrator sets them up. Issuing through the guest My Page and email (from the official manual) Araki Hotel uses the guest My Page. If receipt issuing on the My Page is enabled, it works as follows (the receipt issuing setting is not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). After check-out, guests can issue it themselves from the My Page home screen, entering their own addressee. If there is no receipt amount, it is a statement only. Which documents can be downloaded on the My Page can be switched between allowed and disabled per document in 《履歴》 (History). If the front desk has recreated a document, disable the old one. If you set 「請求明細書の添付」 (Attach billing statement) for check-in in 【自動メール配信設定】 (Automatic email settings) to 「自動送信時に添付する」 (Attach when sent automatically), the PDF is attached to the check-in completion email. It includes all charges and payments at the time it is sent. The property's statement settings (such as combining plan-split charges) also apply to this attachment. To issue separately for each guest (from the official manual) To split receipts by guest within one reservation, adjust the addressee and amounts on the creation screen for each guest and issue one for each person. 《履歴》 (History) after issuing. The statement number, sub-number and created date and time are shown, and you can check the PDF from 「ダウンロード」 (Download). Manage the valid document with the 「有効」 (Valid) column. What the issued statement and receipt (PDF) looks like (sample from the official manual; this is a demo property's form). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル (official online manual, in Japanese))

heading: Reissuing
text: To reissue the same content, press 「現在の日時で再作成」 (Recreate with the current date and time) (the official manual writes it as 「現在の日時で再作成する」; the label on the real screen is not yet confirmed). The statement number stays the same and a new sub-number is assigned.

heading: Corrections and additions
text: To issue something with different content from what was already issued, create a new one from 「明細・領収書作成」 (Create statement/receipt). A new statement number is assigned. When there are several history entries, manage them by checking the 有効 (Valid) column.

heading: 8. Check-in / check-out
text: 【客室の状況表】 (Room status chart) How to check guests in and out in person at the front desk. You do this on 【客室の状況表】 (Room status chart). When you cannot do it from the chart, for example before the check-out date, use the status in the reservation details (see the caution below). Layout of the room status chart (example screen from the official manual. It shows a demo property, with each part explained by labels a–i). (Source: HOTEL SMART official online manual) Ask the guest's name, and find the room for the reservation by eye or by typing the guest's name into the ［当日分の予約検索］ (Search today's reservations) field on the screen (when the search finds it, the room is highlighted). Besides the name, you can also search by group name, the name and furigana (phonetic reading) of the representative or guests, the OTA reservation number, or the room name (from the official manual). Reservations without a room assignment are not shown on the chart, so if you cannot find it, search in 【予約情報】 (Reservation information) (from the official manual). Click the room to open its details. Check what is written, and handle anything that needs action at the front desk. If there is nothing, press 「チェックイン」 (Check in) or 「チェックアウト」 (Check out) to change the status. Normal view. Occupied rooms are shown in yellow-green and vacant rooms in gray, and the number of rooms in each status is shown on the left. View on the scheduled check-out date. Rooms waiting for check-out are orange and marked 『（CO）』. Rooms on a multi-night stay show which night it is, such as 『11／31泊目』 (night 11 of 31). In compact view, you can see the status of every room at a glance from the color of the room number alone (orange = waiting for check-out, yellow-green = occupied, gray = vacant). Details that open when you click a room. You can check the group name, stay period, room and payment status of the charges, and go on to room change, issue receipt or reservation details. 【客室の状況表】 (Room status chart). Rooms due to check in are shown in color, and the count is shown under 「チェックイン予定」 (Due to check in) on the left. In this example, 206 is due to check in (Tokitaka Tanegashima, 1 guest, night 1 of 1). Step 1: The guest's name (e.g. 種子島 (Tanegashima)) typed into the ［当日分の予約検索］ (Search today's reservations) field. The matching room (206) is highlighted, and the search results show the room number, representative's name and check-in code. Step 2: Details that open when you click the room (206). You can check guest information, stay information, memos and charge information, and there are 「チェックイン」 (Check in), 「ルームチェンジ」 (Room change) and 「予約詳細」 (Reservation details) buttons. Step 3: Pressing 「チェックイン」 (Check in) opens a confirmation screen. Check the room (206) and whether to send the check-in notification (off in this example), then press 「保存する」 (Save). 【客室の状況表】 (Room status chart) at check-out. Occupied rooms (206 in this example) are shown in yellow-green, and the count is shown under 「宿泊中」 (Occupied) on the left. Step 1: A staying guest (e.g. 種子島 (Tanegashima)) searched in the ［当日分の予約検索］ (Search today's reservations) field. The search results show the room number (206), representative's name and check-in code. Step 2: Details of the room (206). Because it is before the check-out date, the 「チェックアウト」 (Check out) button is not shown (see the caution below). The operator memo keeps a record of ［ホスト操作：チェックイン］ (Host operation: check-in). heading: Checking in only the guests who arrived first on the tablet (check-in by guest)
text: When guests on a reservation for several people arrive at different times, tablet self check-in lets you skip input for those who have not arrived yet and check in. This can be used when ［宿泊者別チェックイン］ (Check-in by guest) is set to 「許可する」 (Allow) in the property settings. Below is the flow in the official manual (the setting and screens at Araki Hotel are not yet confirmed). Start check-in as usual with the check-in code or QR code, and enter the representative's information. On the companion input screen, press 「全員がお揃いでない場合はこちら」 (If not everyone is here). Uncheck the people who will come later, press 「OK」, and follow the on-screen guidance until check-in is complete. People who arrive later check in on the tablet with the usual steps. A reservation checked in without everyone present gets the status 「一部チェックイン」 (Partially checked in) on the admin screen (from the official manual). From the official manual Guest information for people who come later may not always be entered. For reservations with 「一部チェックイン」 (Partially checked in), check at the front desk whether the people who came later checked in on the tablet and whether the guest register has been filled in.

heading: 9. Room blocks
text: 物件管理 ＞ 部屋情報 ＞ 詳細を見る ＞ ブロック設定 (Property management > Room information > View details > Block settings) When you want to stop using a room for a while, for example for maintenance or broken equipment, use the block feature. A blocked room can no longer be assigned to reservations. Blocks are set in 〖ブロック設定〗 (Block settings) on each room's details screen. They could not be set from the cells of the room allocation chart (checked 2026-10-07). In the list under 【物件管理】＞【部屋情報】 (Property management > Room information), press 「詳細を見る」 (View details) for the room you want to block. In 〖ブロック設定〗 (Block settings), press 「ブロック期間を追加する」 (Add block period) to add a row. Press the period field, choose the start and end dates on the calendar, and press 「OK」. Enter the reason for the block in the memo field. Press 「変更を保存する」 (Save changes) to confirm. Step 1: The list under 【物件管理】＞【部屋情報】 (Property management > Room information) (Tanegashima Araki Hotel. 「1 - 20 / 105件中」 (1–20 of 105) is shown at the bottom). Press 「詳細を見る」 (View details) for the room you want to block. The room details screen (415, twin, in this example). The 〖ブロック設定〗 (Block settings) section is near the bottom. Step 2: A row added with 「ブロック期間を追加する」 (Add block period). Period and memo fields appear, and the period defaults to today through tomorrow. Step 3: Pressing the period field opens a calendar. Choose the start and end dates and press 「OK」. In this example, 2026-10-28 15:00 to 10-29 11:00 is selected. The period and memo (reason for the block; 「【テスト】ブロック」 ([Test] block) in this example) entered. Step 4: The room details after pressing 「変更を保存する」 (Save changes). A blocked room turns purple on the room allocation chart, and the memo is shown instead of the guest name (checked 2026-10-07). The room allocation chart before the block (Tanegashima Araki Hotel, base date 2026-10-27). The room allocation chart after the block. 10/28 for 415 turns purple (blocked) and the memo is shown.

heading: Removing a block
text: In 〖ブロック設定〗 (Block settings) on the same room details, press 「×」 on the row to remove, then press 「変更を保存する」 (Save changes). No confirmation screen appeared (checked 2026-10-07). A row removed with 「×」. Next, press 「変更を保存する」 (Save changes). The room allocation chart after removal. The purple display is gone and the row for 415 is empty. In room selection for a reservation, a blocked room is marked with ×, like 「× 403」, and cannot be selected. On the room status chart too, a blocked room is purple with the memo 「ブロック中」 (Blocked), and it is counted in 「ブロック中」 (Blocked) on the left. Clicking it opens the room details in a new tab (checked 2026-10-09). Room selection for a new reservation. The blocked room 403 has 「×」 and cannot be selected. The room status chart (10/27). 403 is purple and shows 「ブロック中【テスト】…」 (Blocked [Test]…), and 「ブロック中」 (Blocked) on the left shows 1 room. In the block period calendar, dates up to the day before the last closed day are gray and cannot be selected (e.g. at a hotel closed through 10/8, 10/7 and earlier) (checked 2026-10-09). The last closed day itself can be selected on the calendar, but whether a block that includes that day can be saved is not yet confirmed. The block period calendar. Closed dates (10/7 and earlier) are gray, and 「OK」 cannot be pressed either. From the official online manual Blocks on dates that have gone through daily closing cannot be changed or deleted. A blocked room is also removed from the rooms left (inventory). If 0:00 of the next day falls within the block period, that day counts as blocked and inventory goes down. To stop selling that night, make the period cross 0:00 of the next day (e.g. 15:00 today to 11:00 tomorrow). Blocked days are excluded from the occupancy rate calculation. You can also type dates directly into the period field. Araki Hotel has two-way integration with TL-Lincoln, so inventory reduced by a block (and inventory restored by removing it) is also sent to TL-Lincoln automatically (Scene 4 "TL-Lincoln (two-way) and inventory"). heading: 10. Daily closing
text: 売上管理 ＞ 日次締め機能 (Sales management > Daily closing) The daily closing feature finalizes the reservation information for the date you close. It also moves the date of the room status chart forward.

heading: After closing
text: When closing is done, the date of the room status chart moves to the next day. Until you close, the room status chart's date stays on the unclosed day (checked 2026-10-07). Reservations with closed charges or payments also cannot be merged or grouped, and a closed day cannot be set as the scheduled check-in or check-out date and time.
