From the official manual: this becomes the default when you create a reservation by hand. When a reservation imported from the site controller has no time, this time is also used Early check-in / check-in per guest / check-in per room Set each one separately to 「許可しない／許可する」 (Do not allow / Allow). Their meanings according to the official manual are as follows (not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). Early check-in: Lets guests check in on the tablet before the reservation's check-in time. When set to 「許可する」 (Allow), choose how the time from which check-in is possible is decided: 「固定時刻」 (Fixed time) (up to 5 hours before the property's check-in time, in 15-minute steps) or 「相対時刻」 (Relative time) (30 minutes to 5 hours before the reservation's check-in time). If the previous reservation's check-out time is later, it becomes that time or later. This time is not shown to guests and is also used for the validity period of smart lock keys. The tablet shows 「チェックイン可能時間前です」 (It is before the check-in time) when it is earlier than this time (The check-in tablet shows an error). Check-in per guest: For reservations with several guests, lets check-in go through to completion even if not all guests' information is complete. When only some guests are done, the status becomes 「一部チェックイン」 (Partially checked in). Check-in per room: For properties where staff switch the status face to face. When allowed, you can check in and check out each room of a multi-room reservation separately (for steps, see Check-in per room). It was already allowed at the annex (checked 2026-10-06, from front-operations). The setting at Tanegashima Araki Hotel needs to be checked on the real screen. Proceed while unassigned Whether to allow check-in to proceed while no room is assigned. From the official manual: even if allowed, check-in cannot be completed on the tablet alone, and at the end the guest is directed to the front desk (for staffed front desks) Automatic check-out setting Choose when to automatically set the status to checked out, from 1 to 12 hours after the scheduled check-out time (「自動処理を行わない」 (Do not process automatically) can also be chosen) The settings shown when early check-in is set to 「許可する」 (Allow). In this example, 「指定した固定時刻で許可する」 (Allow at the specified fixed time) is chosen with 15:00. You can also specify a relative time, as a number of hours before the scheduled check-in time (example screen from the official manual; this is a demo property's screen). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル) Tip The property name and check-in/check-out times are carried straight into the guest My Page, the tablet and the merge keywords of automatic emails (shown as 「差し込みタグ」 (Merge tags) on the automatic email settings screen, e.g. [物件名（日本語）] (property name, Japanese)). Setting these correctly first makes the later settings go smoothly.

heading: 2. Register room types, rooms and floors
text: 物件管理 (Property management) ＞ 物件情報 (Property information) ＞ 詳細を見る (View details) ＞ 部屋タイプ／階層 (Room types / Floors) section (to add rooms, use 「部屋を追加する」 (Add room) at the bottom of the same property details page) First create the room type containers such as "single" and "double", then add the actual room numbers from the property details page and link the floor information. The 「部屋タイプ」 (Room types) section of the property details page. Enter the room type name, default number of guests and capacity. In the 「部屋タイプ」 (Room types) section of the property details page, enter the room type name, switching between the four language tabs. According to the official manual, you cannot save unless all four language fields are filled in. Room type names currently appear only in the admin screen, so the same Japanese name in all four is fine (from the official manual). Enter the 「デフォルト宿泊人数」 (Default number of guests) and 「定員」 (Capacity) for each room type. According to the official manual, automatic room assignment judges over-capacity using each room's capacity (room information > View details). What the capacity in the room type section is used for needs to be checked on the real screen (not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). Add a type with 「＋部屋タイプを追加する」 (+ Add room type), and delete rows you do not need with the 「×」 on the right. In the 「階層」 (Floors) section, register the building's floor information (floor names) from 「＋階層を追加する」 (+ Add floor); you can then assign a floor to each room. Choose each room's floor in 「階数」 (Floor) in the room information details (from the official manual; for its use, see the tip in scene 3). Register individual room numbers from 「部屋を追加する」 (Add room) at the bottom of the property details page. 【物件管理】＞【部屋情報】 (Property management > Room information) is the screen for viewing and filtering registered rooms. 「階数」 (Floor) in the room information details. The floors created in 「階層」 (Floors) on the property details page appear in the dropdown (example screen from the official manual; this is a demo property's screen). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル) Main fields in the room details (room information > View details) (from the official manual; limited to the fields Araki Hotel uses) Room number Room number or room name Room type Choose from the dropdown. Automatic room assignment is based on this room type. If you change the room type, the number of rooms per room type on the property details page also changes Capacity Number of people, including children. You can save with it blank, but reservations over the capacity are excluded from automatic room assignment Floor Choose from the floors created in 「階層」 (Floors) on the property details page. Not set at Araki Hotel (checked 2026-10-09; see the tip in scene 3) Key number / room entry instructions The key number, which can be given on the check-in completion screen or by email, and room entry instructions per language (the merge keyword ［鍵番号］ (key number) can be used). How Araki Hotel uses these is not confirmed Block setting Used to stop selling a room because of a fault, repairs and so on (Block a room) The 「部屋タイプを追加する」 (Add room type) button and the 「階層」 (Floors) registration section below it (階層を追加する (Add floor)). Caution Renaming a room type later also affects how it is shown in its links to existing reservations, charge settings and rate plans. We recommend finalizing the names before you start operating.

heading: 3. Room status chart layout
text: 客室の状況表 (Room status chart) ＞ 「レイアウト変更」 (Change layout) at the bottom right of the screen Arrange the rooms by building floor so that the status of every room can be seen at a glance on the room status chart. Newly registered rooms are just lined up in one row under 「未配置の部屋」 (Unplaced rooms), so always place them after registering. Araki Hotel's placement rules (checked 2026-10-09) Row Contents Rooms 1 5th floor 501, 502 (2 rooms) 2 4th floor 401–420 (20 rooms) 3 3rd floor 301–320 (20 rooms) 4 2nd floor 201–209, 260–263 (condominium) (13 rooms) 5 Cabins 1–24 (24 rooms) 6 Capsules CP1–CP20 (20 rooms) 7 赤尾木荘 (Akaogi-so) 赤1–赤6 (Aka 1–Aka 6) (6 rooms) The placement of all 105 Araki Hotel rooms, seen in compact view. From the top: 5th floor down to 2nd floor, then cabins, capsules and 赤尾木荘 (Akaogi-so). From the top row, place the floors in descending order from 5th to 2nd, then below them cabins, capsules and 赤尾木荘 (Akaogi-so), in that order. Within each row, place rooms from left to right in ascending room number order. All 105 rooms are already set up in this layout (0 unplaced rooms, checked 2026-10-09). The annex (4 rooms) is a separate property, and its rooms are placed on its own room status chart. Open the room status chart and choose 「種子島あらきホテル」 (Tanegashima Araki Hotel) as the property. Click 「レイアウト変更」 (Change layout) at the bottom right of the screen. A confirmation 「部屋の配置を変更しますか？」 (Change the room layout?) appears; click OK to enter edit mode (⊕ buttons appear above, below, left and right of the layout grid). Drag and drop rooms from 「未配置の部屋」 (Unplaced rooms) to their positions according to the placement rules. If there are not enough cells (rows/columns), add them with the ⊕ buttons above, below, left and right of the layout grid. When you have finished placing, click 「レイアウト変更」 (Change layout) again. A confirmation 「配置変更を保存しますか？」 (Save the layout changes?) appears; click OK to save. The edit mode screen. Drag and drop rooms from 「未配置の部屋」 (Unplaced rooms) and add cells with ⊕. Save with 「レイアウト変更」 (Change layout) at the bottom right (example screen from the official manual; this is a demo property's screen). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル) Caution If you move to another screen without clicking 「レイアウト変更」 (Change layout), the layout is not saved. When you save, rows and columns at the edges with no rooms in them are removed automatically. Newly registered rooms appear under 「未配置の部屋」 (Unplaced rooms), so place them with the same steps according to the placement rules. Rows with too many rooms to fit on the screen (such as the 24 cabins) are shown with horizontal scrolling. To see the whole chart, use 「縮小表示」 (Compact view) at the top of the screen or full-screen view. Tip 「階数」 (Floor) in room information (物件管理 ＞ 部屋情報 ＞ 詳細を見る (Property management > Room information > View details)) is not set (unspecified) as of 2026-10-09 (checked 2026-10-09). It seems to be the field used for filtering by 「フロア」 (Floor) on the room allocation chart, so consider setting it if needed (needs checking). According to the official manual, the floor is used for 「フロア一括割当」 (Floor bulk assignment) (a feature that reserves all rooms on a chosen floor at once when creating a new reservation; for groups such as school trips) (not checked on the real screen). If you take groups, consider setting it (Floor bulk assignment). The official manual does not say whether it affects the 「フロア」 (Floor) filter on the room allocation chart, so this still needs to be checked on the real screen.

heading: 4. Set up the meal menu (meal items)
text: 物件管理 (Property management) ＞ 物件情報 (Property information) ＞ 詳細を見る (View details) ＞ 食事設定／食事項目 (Meal settings / Meal items) section These settings are for properties that serve meals such as breakfast and dinner. You can have meals reflected automatically in rate plans at booking, and manage meal locations and serving times. Not currently used at Araki Hotel We do not serve meals at present, so do not change these settings. If we start serving meals in the future, set them up after checking with the manager (person in charge) and HOTEL SMART. Meal settings: fields Breakfast charge posting date Choose "serving day" or "previous day". Affects the tally date in sales reports Meal items From 「＋食事項目を追加する」 (+ Add meal item), register each meal item's name / category / charge item / unit price / meal location / serving time 「朝食料金計上日設定」 (Breakfast charge posting date setting) in meal settings. Choose 「提供日計上」 (Post on serving day) or 「前日計上」 (Post on previous day) (example screen from the official manual; this is a demo property's screen). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル) 「食事項目」 (Meal items) on the property details page. Register the meal item name, category (breakfast / lunch / dinner), charge item and unit price row by row, and add rows with 「食事項目を追加する」 (Add meal item) (example screen from the official manual; this is a demo property's screen). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル) Tip Meal items registered here are reflected in 「お食事」 (Meals) in the 〖予約情報〗 (Reservation information) section of the reservation creation screen, and in the meal status chart, meal location reservation list and summary table under 【食事管理】 (Meal management). Properties with several meal locations will find it smoother to set up 「食事場所一覧」 (Meal location list) (in the meal management menu) first and then link them here. A note for future use: according to the official manual, if you add a meal to a reservation by hand, its charge is not entered in the charge information automatically (add it by hand).

heading: 5. Choose the fields shown on the reservation screen (reservation detail display settings)
text: 物件管理 (Property management) ＞ 物件情報 (Property information) ＞ 詳細を見る (View details) ＞ 予約詳細表示設定 (Reservation detail display settings) section You can narrow down the fields on the reservation creation and reservation details screens by setting each to "show / hide" to match how the property operates. Hiding fields you do not use keeps the screen uncluttered during front desk work. The reservation detail display settings screen. The first item is floor bulk assignment (ON / OFF); for the items below it, choose 「表示する／表示しない」 (Show / Hide) (example screen from the official manual; this is a demo property's screen). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル) Fields that can be shown or hidden Floor bulk assignment ON / OFF. In the official manual this is the first item in the table; when ON, you can assign all rooms on one floor at once on the new reservation screen (for groups; Floor bulk assignment). The setting at Araki Hotel is not confirmed Cleaning notes A field for special cleaning notes linked to the reservation Means of transport / participation type How the guest arrives, and their participation category within a group Meals The meal selection UI in the reservation information section. According to the official manual, showing it makes meal management available Provisional reservation checkbox A flag showing that the reservation is not yet officially confirmed Facility reservations The field for reserving facilities such as meeting rooms and parking. According to the official manual, showing it makes facility management available Cost information / invoices Whether payment and invoice information is shown This group of settings has no article of its own on the online manual site (article list). However, the articles on floor bulk assignment, meal management and facility management each explain this setting.

heading: 6. Initial settings for the room allocation chart
text: 物件管理 (Property management) ＞ 物件情報 (Property information) ＞ 詳細を見る (View details) ＞ 部屋割り表設定 (Room allocation chart settings) section This setting decides what is shown first when you open the 【予約管理】＞【部屋割り表】 (Reservation management > Room allocation chart) screen. Filter mode default Choose ON / OFF. When ON, the filter panel is already open when you open the room allocation chart

heading: 7. Register facilities and arranged items
text: 物件管理 (Property management) ＞ 物件情報 (Property information) ＞ 詳細を見る (View details) ＞ 付帯設備／手配品 (Facilities / Arranged items) section Register "facility" booking slots such as meeting rooms, parking and rental bicycles, and "arranged items" such as amenities and rental goods, each separately. Facilities Register the facility name and capacity from 「＋付帯施設を追加する」 (+ Add facility). Used on the 【付帯設備管理】＞【設備利用状況】 (Facility management > Facility usage) screen, which manages usage on a timeline. To use it, set 「付帯設備予約」 (Facility reservations) to 「表示する」 (Show) in reservation detail display settings (from the official manual). In the official manual the button is called 「付帯設備を追加する」 (Add facility) (the wording on the real screen needs checking) Arranged items Register the item name, display order, default quantity and enabled/disabled from 「＋手配品を追加する」 (+ Add arranged item). Reflected in reservation management > arranged item list. An item that has been used in a reservation even once cannot be deleted, so when you stop using it, uncheck 「有効」 (Enabled) (from the official manual) The 「付帯設備」 (Facilities) section of the property details page. Register facilities from 「付帯施設を追加する」 (Add facility) (example screen from the official manual; this is a demo property's screen). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル) The facility details screen. Enter the facility name and capacity and click 「変更を保存する」 (Save changes) (example screen from the official manual; this is a demo property's screen). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル) The 「手配品」 (Arranged items) section of the property details page. Registered items are listed, and you create new ones with 「手配品を追加する」 (Add arranged item) (example screen from the official manual; this is a demo property's screen). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル) The arranged item details screen. Set the item name, display order, default quantity and the 「有効にする」 (Enable) checkbox (example screen from the official manual; this is a demo property's screen). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル) Tip Setting a "default quantity" for arranged items saves you entering the quantity when creating a new reservation. From the official manual: enter the display order as an integer of 0 or more and the default quantity as an integer of 1 or more (otherwise it cannot be saved). Even if you uncheck 「有効」 (Enabled), arranged items already added to reservations stay as they are. How they are used after registration (from the official manual, not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel) Facilities: Use them in 〖付帯設備予約〗 (Facility reservations) in reservation details by entering the facility, usage period and number of people. A warning appears when the number of people exceeds the capacity or the time overlaps another reservation (overbooking). Facility charges are not entered automatically, so register them separately in the charge information. Usage can be seen on a timeline in 【付帯設備管理】＞【設備利用状況】 (Facility management > Facility usage). Facility-only reservations: Register reservations that use no room with 「0部屋の予約にする」 (Make it a 0-room reservation) so they do not affect occupancy and similar figures. When such a reservation exists, daily closing shows 「未チェックインの予約があります」 (There are reservations not checked in), but the official manual says you can close as is. Arranged items: Specify the room, arrangement date and quantity in 〖手配品情報〗 (Arranged item information) in reservation details, and check them together by day in 【予約管理】＞【手配品一覧】 (Reservation management > Arranged item list). When you do a room change or move dates, the arranged items move along with it. For operations on the reservation side, see Front desk operations. Caution According to the official manual, once a reservation is canceled its facility information is deleted, and it does not come back even if the cancellation is undone (not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel).

heading: 8. Notification settings (who is told what)
text: 物件管理 (Property management) ＞ 物件情報 (Property information) ＞ 詳細を見る (View details) ＞ 通知設定 (Notification settings) section (right column) These are internal notifications for staff. They are separate from automatic emails to guests, so be careful not to confuse the two. Caution According to the official manual, the property's email address is shown from the start, but nothing is sent to it unless it is checked. Add other recipients with 「メールアドレスを追加する」 (Add email address). After checking the boxes, be sure to save. Types of notifications (recipients set separately for each) Reservation warnings Warnings about reservation data, such as duplicate reservations and errors Reservation updates Notification when reservation details are changed Guest actions Notification of actions guests take on My Page and so on Mobile order notifications When an order is placed through the mobile order feature Tip notifications Notification when a tip is received Daily closing tally complete notification Notification when daily closing processing is complete Smart lock warnings Error notifications about the linked electronic locks Notification settings per property. For each notification type, check the addresses to send it to. Add addresses with 「メールアドレスを追加する」 (Add email address) (example screen from the official manual; this is a demo property's screen). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル) Notification settings can also be opened from the account name at the top right ＞ account name ＞ notification settings 「設定する」 (Set). There you also find the recipients for 「全体対象」 (All properties) (external service warnings, cleaning management) (from the official manual). Separately from email, there are push notifications shown in the PC's browser. Set them for each PC (browser) from the icon at the top right ＞ device name. They cannot be set in private (incognito) mode (from the official manual, not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). The entry point on the account side. Open the contract holder information from the account name menu at the top right, and click notification settings 「設定する」 (Set) at the bottom right (example screen from the official manual; this is a demo property's screen). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル) Push notification settings. For each notification type, check 「受け取る」 (Receive) (example screen from the official manual; this is a demo property's screen). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル) The official manual's list of notifications does not include "tip notifications" or "smart lock warnings". They are listed here as items seen on the real screen.

heading: 9. Invoice and receipt settings
text: 物件管理 (Property management) ＞ 物件情報 (Property information) ＞ 詳細を見る (View details) ＞ 利用明細兼領収書・請求書 角印設定 (Square seal settings for statement/receipt and invoice) / 社内共有情報 (Internal shared information) / 明細書設定 (Statement settings) sections (right column) The property details fields for square seal settings (recommended 400×400px, PNG / JPG), invoice notes, and the invoice system registration number and business name (example screen from the official manual; this is a demo property's screen). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル) Square seal image Register the square seal printed on statements, receipts and invoices (recommended 400×400px, PNG/JPG) Invoice notes setting Notes text shown on all invoices Invoice system registration number / business name Information needed to issue qualified invoices Internal shared information (notes, equipment, file storage) Handover notes between staff, and files such as manuals, can be attached. Not shown to guests Statement settings (combined display of rate plan breakdown charge information) When enabled, the breakdown of charge items linked to a rate plan is combined into one line on the statement Statement settings. Check 「有効化する」 (Enable) for 「プラン仕訳料金情報の統合表示」 (Combined display of rate plan breakdown charge information) to turn on combined display (example screen from the official manual; this is a demo property's screen). (Source: HOTEL SMART公式オンラインマニュアル) Cleaning settings The property details page also has a 「清掃設定」 (Cleaning settings) section, which shows when cleaning schedules are created automatically (e.g. at check-out) and the property notes. According to the official manual, whether they are created automatically and when (do not create / only at check-out / every day during the stay) is changed in 【清掃管理】＞【清掃手配設定】 (Cleaning management > Cleaning arrangement settings). With a setting that creates them, 「清掃待ち」 (Waiting for cleaning) and 「清掃中」 (Cleaning in progress) appear on the room status chart. 「清掃待ち」 (Waiting for cleaning) does not change to 「清掃中」 (Cleaning in progress) until a cleaning report is started. If you do not want cleaning statuses shown, choose 「作成しない」 (Do not create) (from the official manual, not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel).

heading: 10. Set up the check-in tablet
text: 物件管理 (Property management) ＞ 物件情報 (Property information) ＞ 詳細を見る (View details) ＞ under 「設定」 (Settings): タブレット表示設定 (Tablet display settings) 言語選択 (Language selection)チェックイン/アウト選択 (Check-in/out selection)本人確認 (Identity verification) チェックインコード (Check-in code)契約確認 (Contract confirmation)お客様情報入力 (Guest information entry) チェックイン完了画面 (Check-in complete screen)チェックアウト画面 (Check-out screen)ページ全体設定 (Whole-page settings) This section builds the tablet screens that guests actually touch. It has more items than any other part of the initial setup. Work from top to bottom and you will not get lost. Top of the tablet display settings screen. The setting fields are lined up in the same order as the tablet screens: language selection, check-in/out selection, check-in code entry (example screen from the official manual, showing a demo property). (Source: HOTEL SMART official online manual)

heading: ① Decide the identity verification method (page settings)
text: 「ページ設定」 (Page settings) in tablet display settings. Set easy check-in, check-out by tablet, identity verification method, support call, and the seconds of inactivity before returning to the top (example screen from the official manual, showing a demo property). (Source: HOTEL SMART official online manual) らくらくチェックイン (Easy check-in) A mode that skips part of identity verification and form entry to shorten check-in. From the official manual: when set to 「行う」 (Use), three things are skipped: (1) language selection, so the tablet shows Japanese only (language selection remains on a tablet set up for more than one property); (2) the tutorial; (3) guest information entry, but only when every guest has already entered all required items. It is described as meant for staffed hotels with mostly Japanese guests タブレットによるチェックアウト (Check-out by tablet) Whether to offer self check-out on the tablet. From the official manual: setting it to 「行う」 (Use) does not force guests to use the tablet. When set to 「行わない」 (Do not use), the check-in/check-out selection screen that follows language selection no longer appears, and check-out is handled by automatic check-out (Scene 1), the check-out button on guest My Page (Scene 12), or switching the status at the front desk 本人確認方法 (Identity verification method) Choose from 行わない (None) / 確認動画撮影 (Record verification video) / 内部ビデオチャット (Internal video chat). The official manual says 「コールセンター」 (Call center) can also be chosen if you have the paid call center option (not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). From the official manual: check with the public health center how much identity verification is needed. If you verify by taking a face photo, choose 「行わない」 (None) here. The call center only checks the name and, for foreign nationals, whether the passport belongs to the guest; it cannot handle anything else or record 確認動画撮影秒数 (Verification video length) 「5秒×宿泊者数」 (5 seconds × number of guests) or 「3秒」 (3 seconds). From the official manual: 「5秒×宿泊者数」 is based on the number of guests in the reservation; for a 5-person reservation it records 25 seconds no matter how many people actually arrive. When 「リアルタイム確認」 (Real-time check) is set to 「行う」 (Use), the tablet shows a waiting screen until staff approve on the admin screen, and after the set number of minutes it automatically moves on to check-in complete (how to respond: ⑥) 本人確認タイミング (Identity verification timing) When verification takes place, for example after the passport is captured. The official manual says to choose 「パスポート取得後」 (After passport capture) when using internal video chat. Video recording and video chat happen after guest information entry and before check-in is complete サポート通話 (Support call) Turns on a feature that lets guests make a video call from the tablet to the property. From the official manual: the call goes to property staff, not to the call center. On each PC that receives calls, set this per browser: icon at the top right ＞ computer icon ＞ 「ビデオチャット受信物件」 (Video chat receiving property) (the same applies to internal video chat and real-time video checks). Calls are hard to receive on an iPhone or iPad, so a PC is recommended (not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel) 無操作でトップに戻る秒数 (Seconds of inactivity before returning to the top) The number of seconds without any input before the screen resets. The official manual describes this as a setting to keep guests' personal information from staying on the screen Per-device settings. In the screen opened from the icon at the top right (①) → device name (②), use 「ビデオチャット受信物件」 (Video chat receiving property) (③) to choose which properties that device receives calls for (example screen from the official manual, showing a demo property). (Source: HOTEL SMART official online manual)

heading: ② Check-in code settings
text: チェックインコード入力欄（4言語） (Check-in code entry field, 4 languages) The property name in several languages, shown on the tablet (the official manual explains that this screen is where guests choose how to enter, with three options: 6-digit check-in code / QR code / check-in without a code. That does not match "property name in several languages", so check on the real screen what this field is for) チェックインコード不要チェックイン/チェックアウト (Check-in/check-out without a check-in code) Whether guests can skip entering the code. From the official manual: when set to 「行う」 (Use), guests can proceed if a reservation matches all three of: name or phone number, number of guests, and check-out date (the name matches if 3 consecutive characters match). The official manual recommends 「行う」 (Use). Detailed matching rules (from the official manual): for the name, 3 or more consecutive characters from the start of the family name or the given name must match (for example, for Michael Jordan: "Mic", "Jor", "Michael"). If more than one reservation matches, the one with the most matching characters is chosen. The number of guests and the check-out date must match exactly チェックインコード受付期間 (Check-in code acceptance period) How many hours after the scheduled check-out time the code is still accepted

heading: ③ Tutorial and contract confirmation
text: チュートリアル（ウェルカムメッセージ） (Tutorial, welcome message) The first message guests see, which can be entered in 4 languages. From the official manual: there is no automatic translation, so enter the text for each language 契約確認・同意方法 (Contract confirmation and consent method) Choose from checkbox / signature 宿泊約款・定期借家契約 (Terms of accommodation / fixed-term lease contract) Choose 「現地タブレットに表示する」 (Show on the on-site tablet) to show them at check-in and get consent. From the official manual: the default text of the terms is a general template, so replace it with your property's terms (editing it here also changes the terms on My Page and in emails). The fixed-term lease contract is for properties that take long stays as rentals and usually does not need to be set From the official manual: the tablet languages are fixed at four (Japanese, English, Chinese and Korean) and cannot be reduced. For fields where you cannot prepare Chinese or Korean text, enter English (not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel).

heading: ④ Guest information entry
text: For many items, such as name in kana, prefecture, nationality, occupation, date of birth, gender, previous place of stay / next destination, passport number, face photo, ID document, thermometer, vaccination certificate and negative test certificate, you can tick 「必須」 (Required) and 「代表者のみ」 (Lead guest only). You can also use 「＋項目を追加する」 (+ Add item) to add entry patterns for each language/nationality segment. Property-specific questions (custom questions) are created in 【予約管理】＞【カスタム質問】 (Reservation management > Custom questions). Here you only choose whether to show the question, whether it is required or optional, and who it applies to (lead guest only / everyone) (from the official manual). Answers can be seen in reservation details and in 「カスタム質問回答一覧」 (Custom question answer list) on the room status chart (can be exported as CSV). The defaults collect name, address, nationality, contact details (phone number and email address) and a passport photo, in line with the Hotel Business Act. Basically, make the same items required as on guest My Page. Guests who have already entered the required items on My Page can skip entry on the tablet (from the official manual). For passport capture, 「自動判定する」 (Decide automatically), which captures only foreign nationals living abroad, is recommended. If you choose 「確認する」 (Confirm), guests are shown a list of what they entered at the end to check (from the official manual). When all required items are already filled in, the whole guest information screen is skipped, and optional items are not shown either. If you want guests to always see it on the tablet, create one required item that is not shown on My Page. Required items cannot be changed per rate plan or per reservation (from the official manual). Passports and face photos cannot be registered unless a face is visible. Passport face photos can be stored for up to 2 people. For negative test certificates and vaccination certificates, guests only show an image on site, and staff look at the contents and judge (from the official manual). Only when Stripe or mPOS is integrated does a payment screen (⑧ Payment) appear after entry. If they are not integrated, this setting field does not exist (from the official manual; not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel).

heading: ⑤ Check-in complete and check-out screens
text: The 「チェックイン完了」 (Check-in complete) setting fields (left) and how they appear on the tablet (right). Set the guide image, room entry instructions, room information printing, My Page QR code and so on (example screen from the official manual, showing a demo property). (Source: HOTEL SMART official online manual) 案内画像 (Guide image) You can put images such as photos of the key or room on the complete screen. Only images can be added; PDFs are attached to automatic emails instead (from the official manual) 入室案内 (Room entry instructions) Guide text such as room number and key number (multilingual). From the official manual: the text is set per room in 「入室案内」 (Room entry instructions) in the room details (table in Scene 2) 部屋情報印刷 (Room information printing) Choose from no printing / room number only / room number and key number / print message only お客様マイページQRコード (Guest My Page QR code) Whether to show a QR code to My Page on the check-in complete screen 無操作でトップに戻る秒数（完了画面） (Seconds of inactivity before returning to the top, complete screen) How long the final room entry instructions stay on screen. Make it longer if the instructions are long (from the official manual) チェックアウト時の顔写真撮影 (Face photo at check-out) No photo / lead guest only / everyone. The official manual says a photo at check-out is usually not needed and should be set only in areas where the public health center requires it From the official manual: tablet check-out cannot show a payment screen for an outstanding balance. The workflow assumes payment is completed at check-in (not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel).

heading: ⑥ How staff respond (support calls, video chat, verification videos)
text: Araki Hotel uses tablet self check-in. Calls from guests and approval of verification videos are received on a PC with the admin screen open. The following is the official manual's description (how Araki Hotel actually responds is not yet confirmed). In the browser of the receiving PC, set icon at the top right ＞ computer icon ＞ 「ビデオチャット受信物件」 (Video chat receiving property) in advance (image in ①). Choose 「全物件で受信する」 (Receive for all properties), or choose 「対応物件のみを受信する」 (Receive only for selected properties) and select the properties. If notifications do not arrive, check here first. When a call comes in, a notification appears on the phone icon at the top right of the admin screen (it lights up red). If the PC's speaker is on, a ring tone also plays. Click the phone icon to answer, and turn on the microphone and camera. During the call, you can open the reservation information in a separate window from the top left of the call screen. When the matter is settled, staff click 「次の画面に進める」 (Go to next screen). The call ends and the guest's tablet moves on to the next screen. サポート通話 (Support call) The guest calls by tapping 「通話スタート」 (Start call) from the phone (handset) icon at the top right of the tablet. The button appears on screens after language selection. Property staff need to answer 内部ビデオチャット (Internal video chat) As identity verification, the guest calls by tapping 「通話スタート」 (Start call) after guest information entry and before check-in is complete 確認動画（リアルタイム確認） (Verification video, real-time check) A notification arrives after recording. Watch the video and choose from 「次の画面に進める」 (Go to next screen), 「前の画面に戻す」 (Go back to previous screen) or 「トップ画面に戻す」 (Return to top screen). Recorded videos are saved in the cloud, not on the tablet, and can be viewed later in the 〖宿泊者情報〗 (Guest information) section of the reservation details

heading: ⑦ Installing the tablet and handling faults
text: From the official manual (the procedure on Araki Hotel's devices is not yet confirmed): The device arrives already set up. Turn it on, connect it to Wi-Fi and place it upright, and it is ready to use. To set up Wi-Fi, open the three-line menu at the top left of the app screen and enter the admin password (given in the official manual). What is displayed can be changed from the admin screen at any time. Place it where the signal is good and out of direct sunlight. In places that are too hot, too cold or have a weak signal, the battery drains faster. The property provides an anti-theft wire or an outdoor case. If 「ネットワークでエラーが発生しました」 (A network error occurred) appears, try reconnecting to Wi-Fi, switching between 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz, and restarting the tablet, router and modem. If the screen does not turn on, check the charge. The charge status can be seen at the icon at the top right of the admin screen ＞ account name ＞ 「設定する」 (Configure) in 〖タブレット端末〗 (Tablet devices) ＞ 「詳細を見る」 (View details). If touch does not respond, restart by holding the power button and a volume button at the same time, and also check for dirt on the screen or the protective film. Natural failures are replaced or repaired free of charge once per device within the warranty period (the property pays shipping to send it). Drops, water damage, use in high heat or direct sunlight, theft and loss are not covered by the warranty. Check the warranty period on the application form.

heading: ⑧ Fixing tablet errors in the settings
text: From the official manual (for checks at the desk, see The check-in tablet shows an error) 「チェックイン可能時間前です」 (It is before check-in time) Allow early check-in (Scene 1) or move that reservation's check-in time earlier. For reservations that came in from the site controller, stop automatic updates first, or the time will revert (Stopping automatic updates) 「予約に部屋が割り当てられていません」 (No room is assigned to the reservation) Assign a room to the reservation, or allow guests to pass through while unassigned. Even if you allow it, 「フロントスタッフにお声掛けください」 (Please speak to the front desk staff) appears at the end, so it is not suitable for unstaffed hours 「チェックインコードが不正です」 (The check-in code is invalid) Appears when the code is mistyped, and also for reservations whose check-in date is not today Caution If the identity verification method or required items are too strict, guests who are not used to tablets tend to give up or come to the front desk with questions more often. We recommend starting with the minimum required items and adjusting while watching how long check-in actually takes.

heading: 11. Set up automatic emails to guests
text: 物件管理 (Property management) ＞ 物件情報 (Property information) ＞ 詳細を見る (View details) ＞ under 「設定」 (Settings): 自動メール配信設定 (Automatic email settings) Build, template by template, the emails sent automatically to guests at each point from reservation to after the stay. Insert tags (insert keywords, for example [代表者名] (lead guest name) and [お客様マイページのURL] (guest My Page URL)) can be used in the subject and body. The official manual says this screen labels them 「差し込みタグ」 (Insert tags), and a tag is inserted where the cursor is (or into the body if there is no cursor). Types of email you can set up お客様マイページ送信 (Send guest My Page) Set automatic sending (lead guest only / all guests) and send timing (from when the reservation is created up to 180 days before check-in). From the official manual: This email sends the My Page URL and asks the guest to enter information before the stay. It is separate from the booking confirmation email sent by the booking site. The default text has four languages side by side: Japanese, English, Chinese and Korean. You may delete languages you do not use, based on your guests. Rewrite the description of the items you ask guests to enter to match the items in guest My Page settings. Most properties send it 「予約作成時」 (When the reservation is created). Entries tend to increase 1–2 weeks before check-in, so sending it around then is also recommended. Reservations that come in after the set date and time get it when the reservation is created. お客様情報入力リマインド (Guest information entry reminder) Reminder email to guests who have not filled in My Page. You can set the sending period and interval (every 1–10 days) チェックインコード送信 (Send check-in code) Email that sends the check-in code, key number, room entry instructions and so on. You can also set resending and whether to attach a check-in QR code. The official manual says it is also sent at 20:00 the day before check-in, in addition to the set date and time (unless you set 「1日前」 (1 day before)) チェックイン時／チェックアウト時通知 (Check-in / check-out notification) Prepare templates per language and also set things such as whether to attach the receipt automatically. In the official manual the tabs are named 「チェックイン時送信／チェックアウト時送信」 (Send at check-in / Send at check-out) 通知アドレス (Notification address) A field in the Send at check-in and Send at check-out tabs. If you enter the property's address, staff receive a notification email when a guest checks in or checks out (from the official manual; not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel) BCC設定 (BCC settings) For each email, choose the BCC recipient from 「設定しない／ホスト／物件／ホスト＋物件」 (None / Host / Property / Host + Property) Caution Switching tabs does not save. 「変更を保存する」 (Save changes) at the bottom of the screen saves the changes in all tabs at once (from the official manual). You can also save with Ctrl+S (⌘+S on a Mac). The tabs are arranged from left to right in the order they are sent (after reservation → before check-in → check-in → check-out). Even if the recipient is set to 「行わない」 (Do not send), you can still send manually from the reservation details. Companions' email addresses are usually not imported, so 「代表者のみ」 (Lead guest only) is enough for the recipient (from the official manual). Attachments must be under 1 MB each, up to 5 files. Depending on the recipient's environment, attachments may not be visible, so for documents you must get to the guest, make a PDF and put its URL in the body (from the official manual). The 「送信」 (Send) and 「再送」 (Resend) buttons in the reservation details send regardless of the automatic sending settings. Do not put a real address in a test reservation and press them (from the official manual). Emails do not reach guests on reservations from booking sites that do not import email addresses, such as Rakuten Travel, Ikyu and Airbnb (from the official manual). SMS-related items cannot be used unless the SMS feature itself has been enabled separately. The official manual says SMS is a paid option contracted through your sales representative. Once contracted, the setting fields appear under each of the 「お客様マイページ送信」 (Send guest My Page), 「お客様情報入力リマインド」 (Guest information entry reminder) and 「チェックインコード送信」 (Send check-in code) tabs. Araki Hotel does not use SMS or LINE, so guests are contacted by email.

heading: 12. Set up guest My Page
text: 物件管理 (Property management) ＞ 物件情報 (Property information) ＞ 詳細を見る (View details) ＞ under 「設定」 (Settings): お客様マイページ設定 (Guest My Page settings) Set the entry items and displayed content of the dedicated page that guests can check in a web browser before and after their stay. A My Page is created for each reservation. Araki Hotel sends the URL by automatic email (Scene 11) (not by SMS or LINE). お客様情報 入力項目 (Guest information entry items) For each language/nationality segment, set required / lead guest only for items such as name, name in kana, nationality, date of birth, passport number, face photo and ID document. From the official manual: There are 19 items to choose from, and their order on My Page is fixed and cannot be changed. 「日本在住／海外在住」 (Living in Japan / Living abroad) is always asked, so it does not appear in the settings. Passport number and passport photo appear only for guests who select foreign nationality and living abroad. Postal code appears only for guests living in Japan, and the address can be filled in automatically. Ticking 「代表者のみ」 (Lead guest only) means companions do not need to enter it. You cannot split it as "required for the lead guest, optional for companions". The defaults are the items required by the Hotel Business Act (name, address, nationality, contact details, passport photo). Adjust them to local ordinances and your property's workflow, and match them with the tablet entry items. お客様情報入力（カスタム質問） (Guest information entry, custom questions) Setting to show property-specific questions. The official manual says the questions themselves are created in 【予約管理】＞【カスタム質問】 (Reservation management > Custom questions), and here you choose whether to show them, whether they are required or optional, and who they apply to (lead guest only / everyone). Answers can be seen in reservation details and in 「カスタム質問回答一覧」 (Custom question answer list) on the room status chart 領収書発行 (Receipt issuing) Whether to show a receipt request on My Page and whether to allow download. From the official manual: when the guest answers 「必要」 (Needed), a field for the addressee name appears. You can also ask for the preferred issuing method and other requests. Download from My Page becomes available after check-out 宿泊約款・施設情報・予約情報・チェックアウトボタン (Terms of accommodation, property information, reservation information, check-out button) Choose individually whether to show each one on My Page. The official manual says the text of the terms is edited not here but in 「契約確認」 (Contract confirmation) in tablet display settings (the same text appears on My Page). Also from the official manual: If you add a web page URL to the terms of accommodation, a 「詳細はこちら」 (Details here) button appears below the terms and opens that page. For property information, choose from 「非表示／マイページに表示／施設サイトを直接表示する」 (Hide / Show on My Page / Show the property website directly). When shown, the property name, address and phone number from the property details appear. With 「施設サイトを直接表示する」 (Show the property website directly), guests are taken instead to a page you specify, such as the official website. When reservation information is shown, the number of rooms and the scheduled check-in and check-out dates (and times) appear. Use 「利用期間の時刻表示」 (Show times for the stay period) to choose whether to show times or dates only. 常時チェックインコード発行 (Always issue check-in code) If allowed, guests can see the code on My Page even before the check-in date チェックイン後のゲスト情報更新 (Guest information updates after check-in) Whether guests can edit their own information after check-in is complete 挨拶メッセージ (Greeting message) Multilingual welcome text shown at the top of My Page 「お客様情報項目」 (Guest information items) in guest My Page settings. Choose 「必須」 (Required) and 「代表者のみ」 (Lead guest only) for each item, and add more with 「項目を追加する」 (Add item) (example screen from the official manual, showing a demo property). (Source: HOTEL SMART official online manual) The 「有効化機能」 (Enabled features) section. Choose whether to show the terms of accommodation, property information, reservation information and check-out button on My Page, and set how times are shown for the stay period (example screen from the official manual, showing a demo property). (Source: HOTEL SMART official online manual) The 「領収書発行」 (Receipt issuing) section. Choose whether to show the issuing request, preferred issuing method and other requests on My Page, and whether to allow receipt download (example screen from the official manual, showing a demo property). (Source: HOTEL SMART official online manual) Caution: receipts are not delivered automatically Even if a guest answers on My Page that they need a receipt or want an electronic one, the system does not create or send the receipt automatically (from the official manual). The answer goes into the reservation's shared notes, and on the room status chart a 「要領収書」 (Receipt required) icon appears on that room. When you notice it, create the receipt manually from the reservation details and give it to the guest by allowing download, by email, or by hand (steps: Issuing statements and receipts, Issue a receipt).

heading: 13. Set up automatic room assignment
text: 物件管理 (Property management) ＞ 物件情報 (Property information) ＞ 詳細を見る (View details) ＞ under 「設定」 (Settings): 自動部屋割り設定 (Automatic room assignment settings) 自動部屋割り (Automatic room assignment) Choose, in the range from 「行わない」 (Do not run) to 「チェックイン90日前の予約まで実行」 (Run for reservations up to 90 days before check-in), how far ahead reservations get rooms assigned automatically ローテーション部屋割り (Rotation room assignment) Use / do not use. Use it to spread occupancy evenly across rooms of the same room type 部屋割り優先順位 (Room assignment priority) A priority can be set for each room number (available when rooms are registered in the list) Automatic room assignment settings at Tanegashima Araki Hotel. Automatic room assignment is 「当日チェックインの予約のみ実行」 (Run only for same-day check-in reservations), rotation room assignment is 「行う」 (Use), and room assignment priority is 「未指定」 (Not specified) (checked 2026-10-09). When it runs The daily process based on these settings runs from around 1:00 a.m. Reservations that come in after the set point are assigned a room immediately. Assignment order With rotation on, rooms that have been vacant longest are preferred, and this is applied before the room assignment priority. The priority is used when vacant periods are equal, and if the priority is also equal, the room with the smaller capacity comes first. Official recommendation For properties with multiple rooms, 「当日チェックインの予約のみ実行」 (Run only for same-day check-in reservations) is recommended. Assigning too early makes room moves during multi-night stays more likely, and once a room is assigned, room type changes from OTAs or the site controller may not be reflected. Manual assignment in daily work and checks when assignment fails

heading: 14. Choose payment methods for the payment screen
text: 物件管理 (Property management) ＞ 物件情報 (Property information) ＞ 詳細を見る (View details) ＞ under 「設定」 (Settings): 支払い方法設定 (Payment method settings) Narrow the payment method choices on the payment screen down to the ones you actually use. Dozens of payment methods are provided in 11 categories: 「売掛無し」 (No receivable), 「予約経路」 (Booking channel), 「決済代行サービス」 (Payment service provider), 「クレジットカード」 (Credit card), 「電子マネー」 (E-money), 「ID決済」 (ID payment), 「売掛」 (Receivable), 「行政補助金」 (Government subsidy), 「前受」 (Advance payment), 「アクワイアラー」 (Acquirer) and 「その他」 (Other). Choose whether 「支払/入金日の初期値」 (Default payment/deposit date) is the current date or the daily closing date. Switch only the payment methods actually used at the property to 「表示する」 (Show), and those not used to 「表示しない」 (Hide) (cash, bank transfer, credit cards, e-money, QR code payment, receivable payment, advance payment and so on). Confirm with 「変更を保存する」 (Save changes). The payment method settings screen. Payment methods are listed by category, and you choose 「表示する／表示しない」 (Show / Hide) for each (example screen from the official manual, showing a demo property). (Source: HOTEL SMART official online manual) Caution If unused payment methods are left showing, front desk staff are more likely to choose the wrong one at payment. We recommend narrowing the list to the payment methods you have introduced. The official manual says show/hide applies only to the reservation payment entry screen and the non-reservation payment entry screen; payment methods set to 「表示しない」 (Hide) still appear in the PCA accounting settings, the reservation CSV and the payment information CSV.

heading: 15. Check common master data and tax settings
text: 設定 (Settings) at the bottom left of the screen ＞ マスターデータ設定 (Master data settings) / 入湯税・宿泊税設定 (Bathing tax / accommodation tax settings) These settings are shared by all properties and affect charge items and tax calculation. Do not change them in daily front desk work; an administrator checks them when operations start or when the rules change. Administrators only Changes can affect reservation charges, payments and reports. Register only what the manager (person in charge) at Araki Hotel has approved, and record the settings before and after the change.

heading: Master data settings
text: Open 「マスターデータ設定」 (Master data settings) and check that the charge items used when registering charges are already registered. Check that the names of charge items and the settings shown on screen match the current accounting rules. Do not create duplicate items for the same purpose as existing ones, and ask the manager or HOTEL SMART about any unclear item before changing it. Under 「予約経路」 (Booking channel), click 「編集する」 (Edit), add channels for reservations that do not go through the site controller, such as phone and direct bookings, choose a category (直接予約 (Direct booking) / 国内OTA (Domestic OTA) / 旅行代理店 (Travel agency) / 国外OTA (Overseas OTA) / 企業・団体等 (Companies, groups, etc.) / その他 (Other)), and save. Channels that come in from the site controller are added automatically, so you only choose their category later. These channels become the 「予約経路」 (Booking channel) choices when creating a reservation by hand (from the official manual; not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). Check how charges appear on the charge breakdown and receipt with a test reservation before using them in live operation. 「料金科目を追加」 (Add charge item) in master data settings. Enter the charge item name, sub-category, charge category, standard tax class and standard unit price (example screen from the official manual, showing a demo property). (Source: HOTEL SMART official online manual) Editing booking channels. Open it with 「編集する」 (Edit) under 「予約経路」 (Booking channel) (①), add a row with 「予約経路を追加する」 (Add booking channel) (②), enter the channel name and category (③), and save with 「変更を保存する」 (Save changes) (④) (example screen from the official manual, showing a demo property). (Source: HOTEL SMART official online manual) Before renaming a charge item From the official manual (supplement to step 2): When connected to a site controller, do not rename the two items 「宿泊費」 (Accommodation charge) and 「ポイント利用」 (Points used). These names are used at every import, so even if you rename them, an item with the original name is created again at the next import. After renaming, some screens show past charges under the new name too, such as charges in reservation details and the reservation CSV. On the other hand, the income and expense report, the on-hand report and invoices already issued keep the old name (amounts do not change). An item that has been used in a charge even once cannot be deleted. Other places where past entries also take the new name include the accounting journal, the charge/payment update history CSV, the occupancy output, and invoices and statements issued from now on. If you output the same period from the income and expense report and the accounting journal, the names may not match, so if you rename, the end of an accounting period is the safest time. The original name is not kept, so to change it back, re-enter it by hand. How charge items work (from the official manual; not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel) 大項目・中項目 (Main category / sub-category) Create them with 「編集する」 (Edit) under 「料金科目分類（大項目・中項目）」 (Charge item classification, main category / sub-category) in 【設定】＞【マスターデータ設定】 (Settings > Master data settings). They are used for how reports are displayed and for totals by main category and sub-category in the income and expense report. Items whose main category's category is 「宿泊費」 (Accommodation charge) are counted in the average room rate, and items in 「食費」 (Meals) can be chosen as the posting destination for meal items サイトコントローラーとつなぐとき (When connecting to a site controller) Reservation sales are imported automatically as 「宿泊費」 (Accommodation charge), and points and coupons as 「ポイント利用」 (Points used), so you do not need to create new items. However, these two items also need to be linked to a sub-category (main category). Add items when you want to break down imported accommodation charges, or for additional charges after the reservation 料金カテゴリー（6種類） (Charge categories, 6 types) 通常料金 (Regular charge) / オプション購入 (Option purchase: extra items bought) / 調整金 (Adjustment) / ポイント利用 (Points used) / 税 (Tax: taxes other than consumption tax, such as bathing tax and accommodation tax) / 不計上 (Not counted). Amounts in 「ポイント利用」 (Points used) are subtracted from regular charges, and that amount becomes a receivable from the booking channel. Items set to 「不計上」 (Not counted) are not included in totals 標準税区分・標準単価 (Standard tax class / standard unit price) The tax class and unit price filled in automatically when you register a charge. The default tax class is 10% tax included. Setting the unit price is handy for items whose price does not change 物件 (Property) If you specify a property, the item can be used only at that property. If left blank, it can be used at all properties 並び順 (Order) In the item selection field when registering charges, items are listed by category in the order of the settings screen. You can reorder them by dragging the move button to the left of each item

heading: Bathing tax / accommodation tax settings
text: Open 「入湯税・宿泊税設定」 (Bathing tax / accommodation tax settings) and check the target property, tax type, conditions, amount and period of application. The official manual says to use 「＋新規作成」 (+ Create new) to enter the tax type, property, start date (the stay date from which the tax applies; dates before today cannot be chosen), the taxable amount and the taxable unit, and then, for each guest category (adult / child A–D), set whether to tax, the method (according to the amount / fixed amount / fixed percentage) and the amount (excluding tax). Check the municipality's latest rules, taxable/exempt conditions and start date with the manager or the person in charge of accounting. When the rules change, test the calculation results, including reservations made before the start date, and start using the settings only after approval. Bathing tax / accommodation tax setting details. At the top, choose the tax type, property, start date, taxable amount and so on, then set the tax method and amount for each category such as adult and child (example screen from the official manual, showing a demo property). (Source: HOTEL SMART official online manual) Needs checking Item names, input fields and calculation methods may differ depending on your contract and permissions. Do not enter tax rates or exemption conditions by guesswork; compare the real screen with the municipality's rules. From the official manual Tax is applied automatically to reservations imported from the site controller or booking engine. Reservations imported before the setting was made are not taxed until they are updated. When entering tax by hand, use a charge item whose charge category is 「税」 (Tax). With any other item, it does not appear in the bathing tax / accommodation tax monthly summary. Non-reservation charges are not counted either. There are three tax methods: 「金額に応じて」 (According to the amount), which sets the tax for each band of room charge; 「一定の金額」 (Fixed amount), a set amount per person per night; and 「一定の割合」 (Fixed percentage), a percentage of the charge. To not tax children, set that category to 「課税しない」 (Do not tax). Bathing tax for day guests (no overnight stay) is set separately with the tax type 「入湯税（デイユース）」 (Bathing tax, day use). When the tax rate changes, add a setting with the revision date as the start date. Guests are not taxed twice by the old and new settings. The start date cannot be earlier than today. Totals can be seen in 【分析帳票】＞「入湯税・宿泊税_月計表」 (Analysis reports > Bathing tax / accommodation tax monthly summary), and printed from 「入湯税/宿泊税集計を印刷する」 (Print bathing tax / accommodation tax summary) at the top right of the screen.

heading: Settings for using advance payments (companies and groups)
text: 法人・団体管理 (Company/group management) ＞ 法人・団体一覧 (Company/group list) ＞ 法人・団体詳細 (Company/group details) This feature manages deposits, drawdowns and balances for each company or group when you receive payment for stays in advance from a group or company (advance payment). The following is the official manual's description (not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). In 「法人・団体情報の編集」 (Edit company/group information) in the company/group details, set ［前受金設定］ (Advance payment setting) to 「行う」 (Use) and save. If the same party pays advance payments into different bank accounts, register them as separate companies/groups to keep them apart. When a deposit is received, click 「前受金情報作成」 (Create advance payment record) in 〖前受金管理〗 (Advance payment management) in the company/group details to register it. Draw down on the payment screen of a reservation linked to that company/group (payment steps). For non-reservation payments too, you can draw down if you attach the company/group when creating the new entry. Drawdowns appear in reports and balances only after the daily closing totals for the drawdown date are complete. Check deposits and drawdowns in 【売上管理】＞「前受金報告書」 (Sales management > Advance payment report) (or the advance payment report in the company/group details), specifying the company/group, property and period. Companies/groups with insufficient balance appear on the daily closing screen. Advance payment deposits for a period can also be seen in the income and expense report.

heading: Site controller: TL-Lincoln (two-way integration)
text: Araki Hotel's site controller is TL-Lincoln, connected two-way. With two-way, in addition to importing reservations from TL-Lincoln (1way), inventory reduced by reservations and blocks created in HOTEL SMART is sent back to TL-Lincoln. For this reason, inventory (the number of rooms put on sale) is managed as HOTEL SMART's sales inventory, and the number of remaining rooms is not changed directly in the TL-Lincoln admin screen. The mechanism and settings below are as explained in the official manual (Araki Hotel's settings screen is not yet confirmed). The inventory sent to TL-Lincoln is calculated as "rooms − reservations − blocks + adjustment", and any change is sent automatically. It can take up to about 15 minutes to be reflected. Every time you add, change or cancel a reservation, set a block or change the adjustment, the inventory is sent. You do not need to fix the inventory on the TL-Lincoln side by hand after changing dates. Even if you change the number of remaining rooms by hand in TL-Lincoln, it is overwritten with HOTEL SMART's number at the next send. Inventory cannot be sent to allotments set to 「照会のみ」 (Inquiry only) on the TL-Lincoln side. TL-Lincoln's inventory is split into two streams: 「ネット販売」 (Online sales) and 「旅行会社」 (Travel agencies). Online sales are managed per 「ネット室タイプグループ」 (online room type group), and booking sites in the same group share the remaining rooms (inventory cannot be split by site). Travel agencies are managed per "sales destination code × travel agency room type × allotment". To hold rooms for each travel agency, use a separate feature called allotment integration. On the 【TL-リンカーン連携】 (TL-Lincoln integration) screen, register the user ID and password to start the 1way integration, then run 「部屋タイプマスター取得」 (Get room type master) and 「予約情報取得」 (Get reservation data) in 〖アカウント情報〗 (Account information) on the right. Complete the 「販売在庫」 (Sales inventory) settings below (sales room types and sales inventory calendar). In 【TL-リンカーン連携】＞「詳細を見る」＞【アカウント設定】 (TL-Lincoln integration > View details > Account settings), under 〖アカウント情報〗 (Account information), press 「開始」 (Start) for ［販売在庫連携］ (Sales inventory integration) (if there is no button, ask support to enable it). Inventory for the period created in the sales inventory calendar is synced from today up to the end of the same month of the following year at most. On the same screen, in 〖在庫連携設定（ネット販売）〗 (Inventory integration settings (online sales)) for each online room type group, and in 〖在庫連携設定（旅行会社）〗 (Inventory integration settings (travel agencies)) for each sales destination code (allotment), choose ［割当て先販売在庫］ (Target sales inventory) and press 「変更を保存する」 (Save changes). If a room type on sale has no target, inventory is not sent correctly. Caution (from the official manual) Two-way can be stopped with the 「停止」 (Stop) button of ［販売在庫連携］ (Sales inventory integration), but if you stop it, inventory is no longer sent to TL-Lincoln. Consult support before stopping it. At Araki Hotel, do not operate it without the manager's decision.

heading: Sales inventory (sales room types and sales inventory calendar)
text: 販売管理 ＞ 販売部屋タイプ／販売在庫 ＞ 販売在庫カレンダー (Sales management > Sales room types / Sales inventory > Sales inventory calendar) The screen for managing the inventory numbers reported to the site controller through the two-way integration. The following is as explained in the official manual (Araki Hotel's settings are not yet confirmed). In 【販売部屋タイプ】 (Sales room types), choose the property, then from 「項目を追加する」 (Add item) enter the sales room type name, the initial adjustment value and the room types to link, and save. Matching the names and order to the TL-Lincoln side makes them easier to follow. If you link several room types, inventory is used from the room type at the top first. In 【販売在庫カレンダー】 (Sales inventory calendar), choose the property and period and press 「在庫数を表示する」 (Show inventory). At first, 「販売在庫が作成されていない期間があります」 (There are periods with no sales inventory created) appears, so press 「指定期間の販売在庫を作成」 (Create sales inventory for the period). Days without inventory cannot be sold, so create inventory up to the furthest date you accept reservations for, and keep adding more regularly. Click an inventory number to open the breakdown, where you can change the adjustment or close out (stop sales). Using close-out requires an application to support. Adjustments within a period can be changed together with 「調整数一括変換」 (Bulk change adjustment). How the sales inventory number is decided (from the official manual) 販売在庫数 (Sales inventory) Remaining rooms + adjustment. If it becomes negative, it is sent to the site controller as 0 残室数 (Remaining rooms) Total rooms − reservations − blocks 調整数 (Adjustment) The difference between the actual number of rooms and the number you want to sell. 0 to sell all, negative to sell fewer, positive to sell more When it is sent When the inventory number changes in HOTEL SMART, and when reservations are imported from the site controller or elsewhere Calendar display Closed-out days are gray, and days without inventory show a warning mark

heading: 17. Set up rate plans and plan charges
text: プラン設定 ＞ プラン情報／プランコード設定／料金自動仕訳設定 (Plan settings > Plan information / Plan code settings / Automatic charge allocation settings), 販売管理 ＞ 料金ランク・料金グループ・料金カレンダー (Sales management > Rate ranks, rate groups, rate calendar) Settings for telling apart the rate plan name, perks and meals attached to a reservation, and for entering plan charges automatically for phone reservations. If you don't use them, reservations can still be created and imported without these settings. The following is as explained in the official manual (the status of Araki Hotel's plan settings is not yet confirmed). Before connecting the site controller Finish creating rate plans and linking plan codes before starting the site controller integration. A rate plan is not attached afterwards to reservations already imported (from the official manual).

heading: Create a rate plan
text: In 【プラン設定】＞【プラン情報】 (Plan settings > Plan information), press 「新規プラン作成」 (Create new plan) and choose the property. Enter the plan name (required) and, if needed, the display name (a short name), plan description (for management, not shown to guests) and perk memo (shown in the reservation details). For plans with meals, check the meal category and choose the meal items (Araki Hotel currently serves no meals. Scene 4). Set the room types to sell and the rate group (can be chosen after saving once), the minimum and maximum number of nights, the check-in / check-out times and the party type. The number of nights and check-in / check-out times are used only when creating a reservation by hand, and the times take priority over the property settings. Press 「保存する」 (Save) at the top right. If there are several properties, you can create a plan by copying another property's plan. Rate plans you create cannot be deleted, and they stay in the order they were created. Rate plan names in the PMS do not have to match those on the booking sites.

heading: Link plan codes
text: Rate plans on booking sites and travel agencies have an alphanumeric "plan code", which arrives with the reservation through the site controller. If you link this code to a HOTEL SMART rate plan, the plan is attached to incoming reservations. You can link several codes to one plan, so plans with different names on each site can be combined into one. In 【プラン設定】＞【プランコード設定】 (Plan settings > Plan code settings), choose the property and rate plan. Enter the plan code and the plan name in the site controller (booking site), and save. If the code differs by even one character it will not link, so copy and paste it. The plan name works even if it differs slightly, but copying it as is makes it easier to tell apart. When a reservation's plan shows 「未選択」 (Not selected) The reservation's plan code is not linked to any rate plan. Look up the code in the site controller (TL-Lincoln at Araki Hotel) or the booking site, and add it in plan code settings (from the official manual; how to look it up in TL-Lincoln is not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel).

heading: Plan charges and automatic charge allocation
text: Reservations coming in from the site controller are imported with their charges, so this setting is not needed for them. Set it up if you want charges calculated automatically when a rate plan is chosen for a reservation created by hand, such as a phone or walk-in reservation. 料金ランク (Rate ranks): Create price-band categories for each day, such as peak / regular / off-season, or the day before a holiday and other days. Even if the charge is flat, one rank is needed for automatic calculation. 料金グループ (Rate groups): Group the charges for each rank by unit, such as rate plan × room type. 料金カレンダー (Rate calendar): Decide which rank applies to each day. プランへの適用 (Applying to the plan): Choose the rate group in the plan's room type settings. With automatic charge allocation settings (【プラン設定】＞【料金自動仕訳設定】 (Plan settings > Automatic charge allocation settings)), you can automatically split part of the room charge into another charge item (example: 1,000 yen of a plan with a QUO Card goes to the QUO Card item). Set the charge item, unit price including tax, per person or per room, and per night or once. It cannot be split between adults and children. Meal charges are allocated in the plan's meal settings, so they are not set here.

heading: 18. Staff accounts and login
text: Icon at the top right of the screen ＞ account name ＞ アカウント設定 (Account settings) 「設定する」 (Set up) Settings for creating a login account for each staff member (child account) and limiting the properties, menus and operations they can use. heading: Create a child account
text: Open the icon at the top right ＞ account name ＞ 「設定する」 (Set up) in 〖アカウント設定〗 (Account settings), and press 「アカウント作成」 (Create account) in 〖アカウント一覧〗 (Account list). Choose the registration method. メールアドレスで登録 (Register with email address): the person sets their password from a link sent by email. ログインIDで登録 (Register with login ID): for front desk staff without an email address; the administrator decides the ID (4–64 characters) and password (8 characters or more). The actual login ID is the ID you entered followed by "#identification ID". Choose the assigned properties and check the menus to show and the operation permissions. Choosing a 「権限グループ」 (Permission group), which bundles permissions for a job role, sets them all at once. Permission groups are created from 「権限グループ一覧」 (Permission group list) at the top right of the account list. For email registration, press 「設定メールを送信する」 (Send setup email). The link expires 1 day after it is sent. Managing accounts (from the official manual) Change the password For people registered by email, the administrator sends a reset email, or the person changes it from the icon at the top right ＞ account name ＞ 「再設定メールを送信する」 (Send reset email). For people with a login ID, only the administrator can change the password Account name Click the icon at the top right, open 〖アカウント設定〗 (Account settings) from the first line, enter the name and save Delete In the permission settings, press 「選択クリア」 (Clear selection) to remove all checks, and save; the account is deleted. An account created with a login ID cannot be recreated with the same ID after it is deleted 「403 アクセス権限のないページです」 (403: You do not have permission to access this page) The account does not have permission for the page that opens right after it logs in (start page). The administrator either changes the start page (〖基本情報〗 (Basic information) in 【契約者情報】 (Contractor information)) or grants permission for that screen What you can't do Permissions cannot be copied, and the permission list cannot be exported or imported

heading: Login security
text: Be careful not to mistype the password: if login fails many times in a short time, that connection source (the hotel's network) is automatically locked out for a while, and you cannot log in even with the correct password. Wait a while, and if it is urgent, ask support to lift it (from the official manual). Passkeys: a mechanism that adds identity verification with fingerprint / face recognition or a security key. The administrator chooses the policy in ［認証器設定］ (Authenticator settings) from 「無効／有効／必須／承認必須」 (Disabled / Enabled / Required / Approval required). Even with "Enabled", once a person has registered, identity verification is required at every login after that. Passkeys are per device, so register again on a different PC. Registering several in case of loss is recommended. Fingerprint and face data are not sent to the server (from the official manual; not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). Restricting connection sources: if someone logs in from overseas or from a connection source whose location cannot be determined, a warning appears in the admin screen's notices and it is recorded. People who have registered a passkey are asked for additional identity verification. Ask support to set allow / deny rules by IP address or country (from the official manual; not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). Single sign-on (SSO) using a company identity platform (SAML) is also available, but whether Araki Hotel uses it is not yet confirmed.

heading: 19. Switching from another company's system
text: Key points of the official manual's recommended steps toward the day you switch from the previous system to HOTEL SMART (switchover date). Araki Hotel's actual switchover steps are not yet confirmed, so follow the manager's plan. Which system to enter reservations in (from the official manual) Reservations checking out before the switchover date Process them in the previous system; do not enter them in HOTEL SMART Reservations checking in on or after the switchover date Enter them in HOTEL SMART. For reservations through the site controller, resend the check-ins on or after the switchover date from the site controller side and import them. Enter reservations that do not go through the site controller, such as phone reservations, by hand Multi-night stays spanning the switchover date Enter them in HOTEL SMART by hand, with the switchover date as the check-in date Past reservations are not moved to HOTEL SMART; view them in the previous system. For new reservations that come in during the preparation period too, stays before the switchover date go in the previous system and stays from then on go in HOTEL SMART. Move accounts receivable and advance payment balances to HOTEL SMART by the daily closing of the switchover date. When entering by hand reservations prepaid on Rakuten Travel, Jalan and so on that span the switchover date, check that the receivable is not duplicated with the previous system. Just before switching, note the number of remaining rooms for each day and room type, and after importing, check that the remaining rooms in HOTEL SMART match the inventory in the site controller (TL-Lincoln) (Sales inventory).
