heading: Reservations and sales
text: PMS A system that manages a hotel's reservations, rooms, billing and more in one place. Here it means HOTEL SMART. OTA An online travel booking site (online travel agency). As a rule, reservations made through an external site are changed at the site where they were made. サイトコントローラー (site controller) A system that connects inventory and reservation data between several booking sites and the PMS. Stopping the integration is the manager's decision. Araki Hotel uses TL-Lincoln. 2way連携 (two-way integration) An integration that not only imports reservations from the site controller (1way) but also sends the PMS inventory back to the site controller. Araki Hotel has a two-way integration with TL-Lincoln (owner's decision, 2026-10-11). According to the official manual, inventory is managed as HOTEL SMART's sales inventory (rooms − reservations − blocks + adjustment), and any change is sent to TL-Lincoln automatically (it can take up to about 15 minutes to be reflected). Reservations and blocks created in the PMS are also reflected in TL-Lincoln's inventory (not yet confirmed at Araki Hotel). 在庫 (inventory) The number of rooms that can accept reservations. Both the rooms actually free and the sales settings affect it. プラン (rate plan) A product for sale that combines charges, meals, cancellation terms and so on. 予約経路 (booking channel) The entry point through which the reservation came in, such as phone, the hotel's own website, an OTA or a travel agency.

heading: Stays and rooms
text: アサイン／部屋割り (room assignment) Assigning an actual room number to a reservation. チェックイン (check-in) The process that puts an arriving guest into the in-house (staying) status. チェックインコード (check-in code) A 6-digit number for each reservation. The guest receives it by email or on My Page and enters it on the check-in tablet to check in. セルフチェックイン（タブレット） (tablet self check-in) The guest enters guest information and completes ID verification on a tablet to check in. Araki Hotel uses it. Tablet self check-in サポート通話 (support call) A feature that lets the guest make a video call from the tablet to the property's staff. It is separate from the paid call center (ID verification only). チェックアウト (check-out) The process that checks charges and keys and sets the reservation to checked out. ノーショー (no-show) The guest has a reservation but does not arrive and does not contact the hotel. If it is to be treated as a cancellation, the front desk can do it, but always report to the manager (person in charge) after you do. Charging no-show fees or refunding is the manager's decision. The official manual advises cancelling as soon as you know the guest will not come (before daily closing), because a reservation left as a no-show is counted in sales and occupancy. On the room status chart it is shown as 「ノーショウ」 (No-show) (a reservation that started on a previous day and has not checked in yet). 客室ブロック (room block) Making a room unavailable for reservations and assignment because of a fault, construction work and so on. 連泊 (multi-night stay) The same guest staying 2 or more nights in a row. 未部屋割り (unassigned) A reservation whose room type is decided but whose room number is not yet decided. 「未部屋割り」 (Unassigned) on the dashboard counts only reservations staying tonight (from the official manual). It does not appear on rooms in the room status chart. Assign it in Room assignment. 自動部屋割り失敗 (automatic room assignment failed) A reservation that automatic room assignment could not put into a room. It happens, for example, when no room of the same type is free. You can find them from the number on the dashboard. おまかせ割り当て (auto-assign) A button in the room assignment area of the reservation details. The system picks a room and assigns it according to the automatic room assignment settings. オーバーブッキング (overbooking) Two or more reservations with overlapping dates are in the same room. Do not move them on your own; contact the manager. ルームチェンジ (room change) A feature that swaps an assigned room for another room. The system suggests candidate rooms. 宿泊変更 (change stay) The screen in the reservation details for changing the number of guests and rooms (change number of guests), the room for each day (change room) and the charges (change amount). 清掃待ち／清掃中／確認待ち／清掃済 (waiting for cleaning / cleaning / waiting for check / cleaned) Cleaning statuses in the cleaning schedule. Waiting for cleaning means it has not started yet, cleaning means work is in progress, waiting for check means the cleaner's report is waiting to be checked, and cleaned means it is finished. 手配（未手配／手配済） (arrangement: not arranged / arranged) Whether a cleaning company or cleaner has been assigned to the cleaning schedule. Araki Hotel has not registered any cleaners. 共有事項 (shared notes) The memo fields in the reservation details. They include the operator memo (for staff; operations such as check-in / check-out are also recorded automatically) and cleaning remarks (for cleaning; not shown on the printed making list).

heading: Charges and operations
text: 事前決済 (prepaid) Already paid before arrival, on a booking site or elsewhere. Check the payment information so you do not charge twice. 現地決済 (pay at the hotel) Receiving payment at the hotel. 未収金 (outstanding balance) An amount not yet received. Check that it is 0 yen or that the correct billing party is set. 料金／精算 (charges / payment) 「料金」 (charges) is the amount billed to the guest; 「精算」 (payment) is the amount actually received (from the official manual). 前受金 (advance payment) Money received before the stay or use. You can see the balance in the report 「前受金・滞在未収金残高一覧」 (Advance payment and in-house receivable balance list). 滞在未収金 (in-house receivable) An amount not yet received from a guest who is staying (checked in). In-house receivable CSV 稼働率 (occupancy rate) The number of rooms sold divided by the number of rooms. It is shown in the middle of the dashboard. 日次締め (daily closing) The process that finalizes the sales and payments for the business day. After closing, they cannot be edited. At properties where it is enabled, the 「日次の締めを行う」 (Do daily closing) button appears after the set closing time, and the manager checks reservations and payments before pressing it to close the day. マイページ (guest My Page) A dedicated page where guests check their reservation and enter information. Araki Hotel uses it (it does not use SMS or LINE notices). If there is a problem, see Problems with My Page. オプション (options) Services and items added to a stay. Pick-up, rental items, extra dishes and so on; the contents differ depending on the property settings.

heading: Key points stated explicitly in the official PDF
text: As a rule, reservations made through the site controller are changed at the source where they were made If you stop the automatic update of a reservation, later changes are not synced Data that has gone through daily closing cannot be edited Check the receipt PDF before printing it Rooms cannot be blocked for periods that have reservations or are already closed (that blocks on closed dates cannot be changed or deleted is also stated in the online version. That rooms cannot be blocked for periods with reservations is stated only in the PDF, not in the online version, and has not been checked on the real screen either)

heading: Questions for HOTEL SMART: room assignment
text: Items that could not be confirmed in the official PDF and online articles, or could not be verified without real data. Please tell us the official procedure for manually assigning a room from the unassigned list in 「部屋割り表」 (Room allocation chart). We would also like to confirm where to drag the schedule bar to and when it is saved. What the official articles tell us: apart from the room allocation chart, manual assignment can be done with ［部屋割り当て］ (Room assignment) in the reservation details (choosing a room number, or 「おまかせ割り当て」 (Auto-assign)) and with 「未部屋割りの予約を割り当てる」 (Assign unassigned reservations) on the room status chart (Room assignment 3.). Dragging is mentioned only in the article on arranged-item management, as an operation to "move an assigned reservation to another free room". → The question can be narrowed to "can a reservation be dragged from the unassigned list to a room?" Is there a way to stop a reservation that was manually unassigned with 「割当解除」 (Unassign) from being assigned again by the next automatic assignment? (That it is reassigned was confirmed on 2026-10-10.) How are room blocks and the check-in / check-out times of the preceding and following reservations taken into account when automatic assignment decides candidate rooms? What the official articles tell us: rooms that are blocked cannot be assigned and are removed from inventory (ブロック機能 article). The causes of automatic room assignment failure listed are no free room of the specified room type, and wrong check-in / check-out time settings on that reservation or the ones before and after it, causing the times to overlap into an overbooking (自動部屋割り設定 article). That it does not look at cleaning status was confirmed on 2026-10-09. → The official articles almost answer this. Please tell us the official correction procedure when a room type change arrives from an OTA or the site controller after a room has been assigned. What the official articles tell us: they only say "once a room is assigned, the change is not reflected" and recommend a setting that assigns rooms shortly before arrival. When the imported room type is wrong in the first place, they advise checking 「部屋タイプ割り当て」 (Room type mapping) in the site controller integration settings. → The question can be narrowed to "may we fix it by hand in the reservation details, and how does that relate to automatic updates?" Is there a screen where we can see the operation history of assignments, unassignments and changes, and who did them? What the official articles tell us: the only histories available are the operation history of charges and payment (料金・精算＿更新情報CSV (charges and payment update information CSV)) and the check-in / check-out, cancellation and stop / resume of automatic updates recorded automatically in the operator memo; there is no mention of a room assignment history. → Kept as a question. Floor bulk assignment can be saved even in an overbooked state; can the function be disabled or restricted by permission? What the official articles tell us: floor bulk assignment can be used only when 「フロア一括割当」 (Floor bulk assignment) is turned ON in 〖予約詳細表示設定〗 (Reservation details display settings) in the property details. It can be read that turning it OFF makes it unavailable. There is no mention of restrictions by permission. → Instead of asking, it is enough to check Araki Hotel's current setting (ON / OFF).
